entries.lead: the battle of breslau was fought on 22 november 1757 in breslau during the third silesian war.

entries.label: Battle of Brest (1794)
entries.lead: the battle of brest, also known as the battle of terespol, took place between russian imperial forces and polish-lithuanian insurrectionists south-west of brest, present-day belarus, on 19 september 1794; the russians won the encounter.

entries.label: Battle of Brice's Cross Roads
entries.lead: the battle of brice's cross roads, also known as the battle of tishomingo creek or the battle of guntown, was fought on friday, june 10, 1864, near baldwyn, mississippi during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Brienne
entries.lead: the battle of brienne saw an imperial french army led by emperor napoleon attack prussian and russian forces commanded by prussian field marshal gebhard leberecht von blucher.

entries.label: Battle of Brier Creek
entries.lead: the battle of brier creek was fought on march 3, 1779, near brier creek in eastern georgia as part of the southern theater of the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Brihuega
entries.lead: the battle of brihuega took place on 8 december 1710 in the war of the spanish succession, during the allied retreat from madrid to barcelona.

entries.label: Battle of Bristoe Station
entries.lead: the battle of bristoe station was fought on october 14, 1863, at bristoe station, virginia, between union forces under maj.

entries.label: Battle of Britain
entries.lead: the battle of britain was a military campaign of the second world war, in which the royal air force (raf) and the fleet air arm (faa) of the royal navy defended the united kingdom against large-scale attacks by nazi germany's air force, the luftwaffe.

entries.label: Battle of Bronkhorstspruit
entries.lead: the battle of bronkhorstspruit was the first major engagement of the first boer war.

entries.label: Battle of Brownstown
entries.lead: the battle of brownstown was an early skirmish in the war of 1812.

entries.label: Battle of Bruderholz
entries.lead: the battle of bruderholz took place on 22 march 1499 in the swabian war between swabian troops and forces of the old swiss confederacy.

entries.label: Battle of Brunkeberg
entries.lead: the battle of brunkeberg was fought on 10 october 1471 between the swedish regent sten sture the elder and forces led by danish king christian i.

entries.label: Battle of Brustem
entries.lead: the battle of brustem was fought on 28 october 1467 in brustem, near sint-truiden between the burgundian state and the prince-bishopric of liege, as part of the second liege war.

entries.label: Battle of Brüx
entries.lead: the battle of brux was fought on 5 august 1421 in north bohemia during the hussite wars.

entries.label: Battle of Buceo
entries.lead: the battle of buceo was a decisive naval battle which took place on 14–17 may 1814, during the argentine war of independence between an argentine fleet under irish-born naval commander william brown and a spanish fleet under admiral sierra off the coast of montevideo, in today's uruguay.

entries.label: Battle of Budla-an
entries.lead: the battle of budla-an was fought on june 2, 1898, between the philippine cebuano rebel forces and spanish and loyalist forces.

entries.label: Battle of Buena Vista
entries.lead: the battle of buena vista, known as the battle of la angostura in mexico, and sometimes as battle of buena vista/la angostura, was a battle of the mexican–american war.

entries.label: Battle of Bulgnéville
entries.lead: the battle of bulgneville was fought on 2 july 1431.

entries.label: Battle of Bunker Hill
entries.lead: the battle of bunker hill was fought on june 17, 1775, during the siege of boston in the first stage of the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Burkersdorf (1762)
entries.lead: the battle of burkersdorf took place on 21 july 1762 during the third silesian war.

entries.label: Battle of Burnt Corn
entries.lead: the battle of burnt corn, also known as the battle of burnt corn creek, was fought on july 27, 1813, in what is now escambia county, alabama, united states.

entries.label: Battle of Busan
entries.lead: the battle of busan, also called battle of pusanpo or battle of busan bay, was a 1592 naval bombardment of anchored japanese ships at busan.

entries.label: Battle of Bushy Run
entries.lead: the battle of bushy run was fought on august 5–6, 1763, in western pennsylvania, between a british column under the command of colonel henry bouquet and a combined force of delaware, shawnee, mingo, and huron warriors.

entries.label: Battle of Bussaco
entries.lead: the battle of bucaco or bussaco was fought on 27 september 1810 during the peninsular war in the portuguese mountain range of serra do bucaco, resulting in the defeat of french forces by lord wellington's anglo-portuguese army.

entries.label: Battle of Butte-aux-Cailles
entries.lead: the battle of butte-aux-cailles took place on 24–25 may 1871 between the paris commune and versaillais government forces in the parisian district of butte-aux-cailles.

entries.label: Battle of Buxar
entries.lead: the battle of buxar was fought on 22-23 october 1764, between the forces of the british east india company (eic), under the command of major hector munro, and the combined armies of mughal emperor shah alam ii and his allies: mir qasim, nawab of bengal; maharaja balwant singh of benares; and shuja-u

entries.label: Battle of Buzenval (1871)
entries.lead: the (second) battle of buzenval, also known as the battle of mont valerien, was part of the siege of paris during the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Battle of Byczyna
entries.lead: the battle of byczyna, also known as the battle of pitschen, was the deciding battle of the 1587–1588 war of the polish succession, which erupted after two rival candidates were elected to the polish throne.

entries.label: Battle of Byeokjegwan
entries.lead: the battle of byeokjegwan was a military engagement fought in the winter of 27 february 1593, between the armies of the ming dynasty led by li rusong and japanese forces under kobayakawa takakage.

entries.label: Battle of Bysjön
entries.lead: the battle of bysjon was fought between swedish and, for the most part, norwegian troops on 22 december 1644.

entries.label: Battle of Byssel
entries.lead: the battle of byssel was the last major military engagement in the second campaign of the ottoman–wahhabi war.

entries.label: Battle of Çıldır
entries.lead: the battle of cıldır was fought on 9 august 1578 during the ottoman–safavid war (1578–1590).

entries.label: Battle of Cabezón
entries.lead: the battle of cabezon was an engagement early in the peninsular war on 12 june 1808 between spain's army of castile, under cuesta, based at valladolid, and detachments of marshal bessieres' french army corps under generals general lasalle and merle.

entries.label: Battle of Cabrita Point
entries.lead: the battle of cabrita point, also known battle of marbella, was a naval battle that took place while a combined spanish-french force besieged gibraltar on 10 march 1705 during the war of spanish succession.

entries.label: Battle of Cacabelos
entries.lead: the battle of cacabelos was fought on 3 january 1809 during the peninsular war at the bridge just outside the village of cacabelos, province of leon, spain, as british forces under sir john moore making their retreat to a coruna.

entries.label: Battle of Cachoeira
entries.lead: the battle of cachoeira took place between june 25 to 28, 1822, during the brazilian struggle for independence in the province of bahia.

entries.label: Battle of Cádiz (1702)
entries.lead: the battle of cadiz was an attempt by english and dutch forces to seize the southern spanish port of cadiz in 1702 during the war of the spanish succession.

entries.label: Battle of Cagayan de Misamis
entries.lead: the battle of cagayan de misamis was fought on april 7, 1900, in the town of cagayan de misamis in mindanao, philippines, during the philippine–american war.

entries.label: Battle of Cajamarca
entries.lead: the battle of cajamarca, also spelled cajamalca, was the ambush and seizure of the incan ruler atahualpa by a small spanish force led by francisco pizarro, on november 16, 1532.

entries.label: Battle of Calamba
entries.lead: the battle of calamba was fought between filipino revolutionaries in la laguna in the philippines and the colonial forces of the spanish empire.

entries.label: Battle of Calatafimi
entries.lead: the battle of calatafimi was fought on 15 may 1860 between giuseppe garibaldi's redshirts and the troops of the kingdom of the two sicilies at calatafimi, sicily, as part of the expedition of the thousand.

entries.label: Battle of Calcinato
entries.lead: the battle of calcinato took place near calcinato in lombardy, italy on 19 april 1706 during the war of the spanish succession.

entries.label: Battle of Caldiero (1805)
entries.lead: the battle of caldiero took place on 30 october 1805, pitting the french armee d'italie under marshal andre massena against an austrian army under the command of archduke charles, duke of teschen.

entries.label: Battle of Calebee Creek
entries.lead: the battle of calebee creek took place on january 27, 1814, during the creek war, in macon county, alabama, 50 miles (80 km) west of fort mitchell.

entries.label: Battle of Callantsoog
entries.lead: the battle of callantsoog was an amphibious landing by a british invasion force under lieutenant-general sir ralph abercromby and admiral lord adam duncan near callantsoog during the anglo-russian invasion of holland in 1799.

entries.label: Battle of Callao
entries.lead: the battle of callao occurred on may 2, 1866, between a spanish fleet under the command of admiral casto mendez nunez and the fortified battery emplacements of the peruvian port city of callao during the chincha islands war.

entries.label: Battle of Caloocan
entries.lead: the battle of caloocan was fought on february 10, 1899 between american forces under the command of major general arthur macarthur jr.

entries.label: Battle of Călugăreni
entries.lead: the battle of calugareni took place during the history of early modern romania on 23 august [o.s.

entries.label: Battle of Calumpit
entries.lead: the battle of calumpit, alternately known as the battles of bagbag and pampanga rivers, was fought from april 25–27, 1899, in calumpit, bulacan, during the philippine–american war.

entries.label: Battle of Calven
entries.lead: the battle of calven 1 took place on 22 may 1499 at the exit of the val mustair in the grisons to the vinschgau in county of tyrol between the forces of king maximilian i of the house of habsburg and those of the free federation of the three leagues of the grisons.

entries.label: Battle of Camacuã
entries.lead: the battle of camacua was fought in april 1827 by troops of the united provinces and of the empire of brazil during the cisplatine war.

entries.label: Battle of Camalig
entries.lead: the battle of camalig in albay province, philippines, was fought on april 2, 1898 between the forces of colonial spanish government in bicol region and bicolanos under bicolano revolutionaries general vito belarmino, simeon ola, and glicerio delgado during the philippine revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Camaret
entries.lead: the battle of camaret, also referred to as the brest expedition, was a notable engagement of the nine years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Camarón
entries.lead: the battle of camaron was a last stand engagement fought on 30 april 1863 between the french foreign legion and the mexican army, during the second french intervention in mexico (1861–1867).

entries.label: Battle of Cambrils
entries.lead: the battle of cambrils or the massacre of cambrils took place in december 1640 during the reapers' war.

entries.label: Battle of Camden
entries.lead: the battle of camden, also known as the battle of camden court house, was fought on august 16, 1780, as part of the southern theater of the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Camino Real
entries.lead: the battle of camino real, was the first battle in the ecuadorian war of independence, that took place on 9 november 1820.

entries.label: Battle of Camp Allegheny
entries.lead: the battle of camp allegheny, also known as the battle of allegheny mountain, took place on december 13, 1861, in pocahontas county, virginia, about 3 miles from the mountainous border of highland county, virginia, as part of the operations in western virginia campaign during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Camperdown
entries.lead: the battle of camperdown was fought on 11 october 1797 between the royal navy's north sea fleet under admiral of the blue adam duncan and a batavian navy fleet led by vice-admiral jan willem de winter.

entries.label: Battle of Campichuelo
entries.lead: the battle of campichuelo was a skirmish that took place on 19 december 1810 when the military expedition sent by the primera junta crossed the parana river from candelaria to campichuelo de la candelaria, where a paraguayan outpost was positioned.

entries.label: Battle of Campo Santo
entries.lead: the battle of campo santo was fought outside camposanto, italy, during the war of the austrian succession.

entries.label: Battle of Campo Tenese
entries.lead: the battle of campo tenese saw two divisions of the french army of naples led by jean reynier attack the left wing of the royal neapolitan army under roger de damas.

entries.label: Battle of Cancha Rayada (1818)
entries.lead: the battle of cancha rayada, was fought in chile between south american patriots and spanish royalists, during the osorio's campaign in the south american wars of independence.

entries.label: Battle of Cane Hill
entries.lead: the battle of cane hill was fought between union and confederate forces during the american civil war on november 28, 1862, in northwestern arkansas, near the town of cane hill.

entries.label: Battle of Cannanore (1506)
entries.lead: the battle of cannanore took place in 1506 off the harbour of cannanore in india, between the indian fleet of the zamorin of calicut and a portuguese fleet under lourenco de almeida, son of the viceroy almeida.

entries.label: Battle of Canton (1856)
entries.lead: the battle of canton was fought between british and chinese forces at the city of canton (guangzhou), guangdong province, china on 23 october to 5 november 1856 during the second opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Canton (1857)
entries.lead: the battle of canton was fought by british and french forces against qing china on 28–31 december 1857 during the second opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Canton (March 1841)
entries.lead: the first battle of canton was fought between british and chinese forces in canton, guangdong province, china, on 18 march 1841 during the first opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Canton (May 1841)
entries.lead: the second battle of canton was fought between british and chinese forces in canton (guangzhou), guangdong province, china, in may 1841 during the first opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Cap de la Roque
entries.lead: the battle of cap de la roque took place on 22 may 1703 between an anglo-dutch convoy protected by a dutch states navy squadron under captain roemer vlacq and a larger french navy squadron under alain emmanuel de coetlogon during the war of the spanish succession.
terms: battle of cap de la roque

entries.label: Battle of Cap-Français
entries.lead: the battle of cap-francais was a naval engagement during the seven years' war fought between squadrons of the french and british navies outside the harbour of cap-francais, saint-domingue on 21 october 1757.

entries.label: Battle of Cap-Français (1793)
entries.lead: the battle of cap-francais took place from 20 to 22 june 1793 during the haitian revolution.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Corvo
entries.lead: the battle of cape corvo was a naval engagement of the ottoman–habsburg wars fought as part of the struggle for the control of the mediterranean.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Finisterre (1761)
entries.lead: the battle of cape finisterre was a naval engagement fought off the northern spanish atlantic coast near cape finisterre between british and french squadrons during the seven years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Finisterre (1805)
entries.lead: in the battle of cape finisterre off galicia, spain, the british fleet under admiral robert calder fought an indecisive naval battle against the combined franco-spanish fleet which was returning from the west indies.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Gelidonya
entries.lead: the battle of cape gelidonya or celidonia took place on 14 july 1616 during the ottoman–habsburg struggle for the control of the mediterranean.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Girardeau
entries.lead: the battle of cape girardeau was a military demonstration of the american civil war, occurring on april 26, 1863 in cape girardeau, missouri.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Henry
entries.lead: the battle of cape henry was a naval battle in the american war of independence which took place near the mouth of the chesapeake bay on 16 march 1781 between a british squadron under vice-admiral mariot arbuthnot and a french squadron under admiral charles rene dominique sochet, chevalier destouche

entries.label: Battle of Cape Kaliakra
entries.lead: the battle of cape kaliakra was the last naval battle of the russo-turkish war (1787–1792).

entries.label: Battle of Cape Ortegal
entries.lead: the battle of cape ortegal was the final action of the trafalgar campaign, and was fought between a squadron of the royal navy and a remnant of the french fleet that had been defeated earlier at the battle of trafalgar.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Passaro
entries.lead: the battle of cape passaro was fought on 11–12 august 1718 off cape passaro between a british fleet under admiral of the fleet sir george byng and a spanish fleet under lieutenant-general jose antonio de gaztaneta during the war of the quadruple alliance.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Rachado
entries.lead: the battle of cape rachado, off cape rachado in 1606, was an important naval engagement between the dutch east india company (voc) and portuguese navy.

entries.label: Battle of Cape Spartel
entries.lead: the battle of cape spartel was an indecisive naval battle between a franco-spanish fleet under admiral luis de cordova y cordova and a british fleet under admiral of the blue richard howe.

entries.label: Battle of Cape St. Vincent (1719)
entries.lead: the battle of cape st vincent was fought on 20 december 1719 as part of the war of the quadruple alliance.

entries.label: Battle of Cape St. Vincent (1780)
entries.lead: the battle of cape st.
terms: batalha do cabo de sao vicente (1780)

entries.label: Battle of Cape St. Vincent (1797)
entries.lead: the battle of cape st.

entries.label: Battle of Cape St. Vincent (1833)
entries.lead: the battle of cape st.

entries.label: Battle of Capo d'Orso
entries.lead: the battle of capo d'orso, sometimes known as the battle of cava and the battle of amalfi, was a naval engagement taking place from 5:00 pm to 9:00 pm on april 28, 1528, during the war of the league of cognac.

entries.label: Battle of Caporetto
entries.lead: the battle of caporetto (also known as the twelfth battle of the isonzo, the battle of kobarid or the battle of karfreit) took place on the isonzo front of world war i.

entries.label: Battle of Carabobo
entries.lead: the second battle of carabobo, on 24 june 1821, was fought between independence fighters, led by venezuelan general simon bolivar, and the royalist forces, led by spanish field marshal miguel de la torre.

entries.label: Battle of Carabobo (1814)
entries.lead: the first battle of carabobo (1814) was a battle in the venezuelan war of independence, in which the forces of the second republic, commanded by simon bolivar, defeated the spanish forces under field marshal juan manuel de cajigal y martinez.

entries.label: Battle of Cardedeu
entries.lead: the battle of cardedeu on 16 december 1808 saw an imperial french corps led by laurent gouvion saint-cyr assault a spanish force commanded by juan miguel de vives y feliu and theodor von reding.

entries.label: Battle of Carillon
entries.lead: the battle of carillon, also known as the battle of ticonderoga, was fought on july 8, 1758, during the french and indian war.

entries.label: Battle of Carlisle
entries.lead: the battle of carlisle was an american civil war skirmish fought in pennsylvania on july 1, 1863, which was also the first day of the battle of gettysburg.

entries.label: Battle of Carmen de Patagones
entries.lead: the battle of carmen de patagones was a confrontation that occurred on march 7, 1827 between militias of the united provinces of the rio de la plata and troops from the imperial brazilian navy, during the course of the cisplatine war.

entries.label: Battle of Carnifex Ferry
entries.lead: the battle of carnifex ferry took place on september 10, 1861 in nicholas county, virginia, as part of the operations in western virginia campaign during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Carpi
entries.lead: the battle of carpi was a series of engagements in the summer of 1701, and the first battle of the war of the spanish succession that took place on 9 july 1701 between france and austria.

entries.label: Battle of Carpintería
entries.lead: the battle of carpinteria was an important battle between troops loyal to the government of manuel oribe and the revolutionary forces led by fructuoso rivera.

entries.label: Battle of Carrickfergus (1760)
entries.lead: the battle of carrickfergus took place in february 1760 in carrickfergus, county antrim during the seven years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Cartagena (1643)
entries.lead: the battle of cartagena was a naval battle fought on 3 september 1643, during the thirty years' war off cabo de gata near cartagena, spain.

entries.label: Battle of Cartagena de Indias
entries.lead: the battle of cartagena de indias took place during the 1739 to 1748 war of jenkins' ear between spain and great britain.

entries.label: Battle of Carumbé
entries.lead: the battle of carumbe, was fought between an army of the united kingdom of portugal, brazil and the algarves and the forces of jose artigas.

entries.label: Battle of Casa Forte
entries.lead: the battle of casa forte was the second major clash in the war of divine light, fought between dutch troops and portuguese militias.

entries.label: Battle of Casaloldo
entries.lead: the battle of casaloldo was fought on 10 may 1509 at casaloldo (lombardy) between the armies of the marquisate of mantua and that of republic of venice, an episode of the war of the league of cambrai.

entries.label: Battle of Caseros
entries.lead: the battle of caseros was fought near the town of el palomar, argentina, on 3 february 1852, between forces of the argentine confederation, commanded by juan manuel de rosas, and a coalition consisting of the argentine provinces of entre rios and corrientes, the empire of brazil, and uruguay.

entries.label: Battle of Casicola
entries.lead: the battle of casicola was an armed engagement between portugal and the kingdom of ndongo on august 24, 1585, during the angolan wars.

entries.label: Battle of Casma
entries.lead: the battle of casma was a naval confrontation that occurred on 12 january 1839 during the war of the confederation between chile and the peru–bolivian confederation.

entries.label: Battle of Cassano (1705)
entries.lead: the battle of cassano took place on 16 august 1705, during the war of the spanish succession, near cassano d'adda, in lombardy, italy.

entries.label: Battle of Cassano (1799)
entries.lead: the battle of cassano was fought in 1799 from 27 to 28 april near cassano d'adda, which about 28 km (17 mi) ene of milan.

entries.label: Battle of Cassel (1677)
entries.lead: the battle of cassel, also known as the battle of peene, took place on 11 april 1677 during the franco-dutch war, near cassel, 15 km (9 mi) west of saint-omer.

entries.label: Battle of Castalla
entries.lead: in the battle of castalla on 13 april 1813, an anglo-spanish-sicilian force commanded by lieutenant general sir john murray fought marshal louis gabriel suchet's french army of valencia and aragon.

entries.label: Battle of Castelfidardo
entries.lead: the battle of castelfidardo was fought on 18 september 1860 near the town of castelfidardo in the marche region.

entries.label: Battle of Castiglione
entries.lead: the battle of castiglione saw the french army of italy under general napoleon bonaparte attack an army of the habsburg monarchy led by feldmarschall dagobert sigmund von wurmser on 5 august 1796.

entries.label: Battle of Castiglione (1706)
entries.lead: the battle of castiglione took place near castiglione delle stiviere in lombardy, italy on 9 september 1706 during the war of the spanish succession.

entries.label: Battle of Castillejos
entries.lead: the battle of castillejos was fought on new year's day, 1860, between the spanish army of africa under leopoldo o'donnell and the moroccan army under mawlay abbas in fnideq (castillejos) as the spanish army attempted to capture the cities of tetouan and tangier.

entries.label: Battle of Castillon
entries.lead: the battle of castillon was a battle between the forces of england and france which took place on 17 july 1453 in gascony near the town of castillon-sur-dordogne.

entries.label: Battle of Castlebar
entries.lead: the battle of castlebar was a military engagement of the irish rebellion of 1798, which occurred on 27 august 1798 near the town of castlebar, county mayo.

entries.label: Battle of Castricum
entries.lead: the battle of castricum saw a franco-batavian force defeat an anglo-russian force near castricum, netherlands, within the anglo-russian invasion of holland.

entries.label: Battle of Catalán
entries.lead: the battle of catalan was fought between the luso-brazilian forces under the command of luis teles da silva caminha e meneses, the marquis of alegrete, and the artiguistas commanded by andres latorre in arroyo catalan, present-day uruguay.

entries.label: Battle of Catirai
entries.lead: the battle of catirai was a battle that took place on january 7, 1569, in the catirai region in chile during the arauco war.

entries.label: Battle of Cătlăbuga
entries.lead: the battle of catlabuga was fought on november 16, 1485, between stephen iii of moldavia and ottoman forces defending the surroundings of chilia.

entries.label: Battle of Cầu Giấy (1883)
entries.lead: the battle of cau giay or paper bridge, fought on 19 may 1883, was one of the numerous clashes during the tonkin campaign (1883–86) between the french and the black flags.

entries.label: Battle of Cecora (1620)
entries.lead: the battle of cecora took place during the polish–ottoman war (1620–21) between the polish–lithuanian commonwealth and ottoman forces, fought from 17 september to 7 october 1620 in moldavia, near the prut river.

entries.label: Battle of Cedar Creek
entries.lead: the battle of cedar creek, or battle of belle grove, was fought on october 19, 1864, during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Cedar Mountain
entries.lead: the battle of cedar mountain, also known as slaughter's mountain or cedar run, took place on august 9, 1862, in culpeper county, virginia, as part of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Čegar
entries.lead: the battle of cegar, also known as the battle of kamenica took place during the first serbian uprising between the serbian revolutionaries and ottoman forces near the nis fortress on 31 may 1809.

entries.label: Battle of Cempoala
entries.lead: the battle of cempoala was fought on 27 may 1520 at cempoala, mexico, between the forces of panfilo de narvaez and the forces of hernan cortes, which were supported by chinantec warriors.

entries.label: Battle of Centane
entries.lead: the battle of centane, also the battle of kentani or the battle of quintana, was fought on 7 february 1878 near kentani ("centane") in south africa's cape province during the ninth xhosa war between 1877 and 1879.

entries.label: Battle of Cepeda (1820)
entries.lead: the battle of cepeda of 1820 took place on february 1 in canada de cepeda, buenos aires province, argentina.

entries.label: Battle of Cepeda (1859)

entries.label: Battle of Fontenoy

entries.lead: the battle of las guasimas of june 24, 1898 was a spanish rearguard action by major general antero rubin against advancing columns led by major general "fighting joe" wheeler and the first land engagement of the spanish–american war.

entries.label: Battle of Las Guásimas (1874)
entries.lead: the battle of las guasimas was fought in camaguey, cuba.

entries.label: Battle of Las Piedras (1811)
entries.lead: the battle of las piedras was fought on may 18, 1811 as part of the rio de la plata war of independence.

entries.label: Battle of Las Queseras del Medio
entries.lead: the battle of las queseras del medio was an important battle of the venezuelan war of independence.
terms: battle of las queseras del medio

entries.label: Battle of Las Salinas
entries.lead: the battle of las salinas was a military conflict and decisive confrontation between the forces of hernando and gonzalo pizarro against those of rival conquistador diego de almagro, on april 26, 1538, during the conquest of peru.

entries.label: Battle of Las Tres Acequias
entries.lead: the battle of les tres acequias, fought during the chilean war of independence, occurred near san bernardo on 26 august 1814.

entries.label: Battle of Laswari
entries.lead: the battle of laswari took place on 1 november 1803 near laswari village, alwar.

entries.label: Battle of Lauffeld
entries.lead: the battle of lauffeld took place on 2 july 1747, during the war of the austrian succession.

entries.label: Battle of Le Bourget
entries.lead: the first battle of le bourget was part of the siege of paris during the franco-prussian war, fought between 27 and 30 october 1870.

entries.label: Battle of Le Mans
entries.lead: the battle of le mans was a german victory during the franco-prussian war that ended french resistance in western france.

entries.label: Battle of Leghorn
entries.lead: the naval battle of leghorn took place on 4 march 1653, during the first anglo-dutch war, near leghorn (livorno), italy.

entries.label: Battle of Leipzig
entries.lead: the battle of leipzig, also known as the battle of the nations, was fought from 16 to 19 october 1813 at leipzig, saxony.

entries.label: Battle of Leliefontein
entries.lead: the battle of leliefontein was an engagement between british-canadian and boer forces during the second boer war on 7 november 1900, at the komati river 30 kilometres (19 mi) south of belfast at the present day nooitgedacht dam.

entries.label: Battle of Lengkong (1826)
entries.lead: the battle of lengkong took place on 30 july 1826, between the forces of javanese rebels under prince diponegoro and a column of soldiers from the dutch colonial army and the yogyakarta sultanate.

entries.label: Battle of Lens
entries.lead: the battle of lens was the last major battle of the thirty years' war (1618–1648).

entries.label: Battle of Leobersdorf
entries.lead: the battle of leobersdorf was fought near leobersdorf on 19 september 1532, as part of the habsburg–ottoman war of 1526–1568.

entries.label: Battle of Lepanto
entries.lead: the battle of lepanto was a naval engagement that took place on 7 october 1571 when a fleet of the holy league, a coalition of catholic states arranged by pope pius v and led by the navies of the spanish empire and the republic of venice, inflicted a major defeat on the fleet of the ottoman empire i

entries.label: Battle of Les Avins
entries.lead: the battle of les avins took place on 20 may 1635, outside the town of les avins, near huy in modern belgium, then part of the bishopric of liege.

entries.label: Battle of Lesnaya
entries.lead: the battle of lesnaya was fought on 9 october 1708 during the swedish invasion of russia in the great northern war.

entries.label: Battle of Leuthen
entries.lead: the battle of leuthen was fought on 5 december 1757 between frederick the great's prussian army and an austrian army commanded by prince charles of lorraine and count leopold joseph von daun.

entries.label: Battle of Leuven (1831)
entries.lead: the battle of leuven or battle of boutersem was a battle of the ten days' campaign during the belgian revolution.

entries.label: Battle of Leuze
entries.lead: the battle of leuze was a large cavalry engagement of the nine years' war that took place on 18 september 1691 between a detachment of french and a superior allied force.

entries.label: Battle of Lewis's Farm
entries.lead: the battle of lewis's farm was fought on march 29, 1865, in dinwiddie county, virginia near the end of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Leybar Bridge
entries.lead: the battle of leybar bridge was fought on 21 april 1855 between the trarza army of mohammed al-habib and the french garrison of the tower on leybar bridge, outside of saint-louis in the french colony of senegal, during the second franco-trarza war.

entries.label: Battle of Liaoluo Bay

entries.label: Battle of Liaoyang
entries.lead: the battle of liaoyang was a major land battle of the russo-japanese war, on the outskirts of the city of liaoyang in present-day liaoning province, china.

entries.label: Battle of Liegnitz (1760)
entries.lead: the battle of liegnitz on 15 august 1760 saw frederick the great's prussian army defeat the austrian army under ernst von laudon during the third silesian war.

entries.label: Battle of Ligny
entries.lead: the battle of ligny, in which french troops of the armee du nord under the command of napoleon i defeated part of a prussian army under field marshal blucher, was fought on 16 june 1815 near ligny in what is now belgium.

entries.label: Battle of Lipantitlán
entries.lead: the battle of lipantitlan, also known as the battle of nueces crossing, was fought along the nueces river on november 4, 1835 between the mexican army and texian insurgents, as part of the texas revolution.

entries.label: Battle of Lipany
entries.lead: the battle of lipany, also called the battle of cesky brod, was fought at lipany 40 km east of prague on 30 may 1434 and virtually ended the hussite wars.

entries.label: Battle of Lipnic
entries.lead: the battle of lipnic was a battle between the moldavian forces under stephen the great, and the volga tatars of the golden horde led by ahmed khan, and which took place on the august 20, 1470.

entries.label: Battle of Lissa (1811)
entries.lead: the battle of lissa, also known as the battle of vis, was a naval action fought between a british frigate squadron and a much larger squadron of french and italian frigates and smaller vessels on wednesday, 13 march 1811 during the adriatic campaign of the napoleonic wars.

entries.label: Battle of Lissa (1866)
entries.lead: the battle of lissa was fought on 20 july 1866 between the italian and austrian navies near the island of lissa in the adriatic sea during the third italian war of independence.

entries.label: Battle of Listerdyb
entries.lead: this battle took place on 16 may 1644 during the danish-swedish war near list deep, between sylt and rømø in western denmark.

entries.label: Battle of Little Muddy Creek

entries.label: Battle of Lleida (1642)

entries.label: Battle of Lobositz

entries.label: Battle of Lodi

entries.label: Battle of Logandème

entries.label: Battle of Loigny–Poupry
entries.lead: the battle of loigny–lumeau-poupry was a battle of the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Battle of Lomas Valentinas

entries.label: Battle of Lomnice

entries.label: Battle of Lone Jack

entries.label: Battle of Long Island

entries.label: Battle of Lucena
entries.lead: the battle of lucena, also called battle of martin gonzalez, was a war event in which christian forces of the crown of castile were faced against the muslim forces of the nasrid emirate of granada.

entries.label: Battle of Luchana

entries.lead: the battle of lund, part of the scanian war, was fought on 4 december 1676, in an area north of the city of lund in scania in southern sweden, between the invading danish army and the army of charles xi of sweden.

entries.label: Battle of Lundy's Lane
entries.lead: the battle of lundy's lane, also known as the battle of niagara or contemporarily as the battle of bridgewater, was fought on 25 july 1814, during the war of 1812, between an invading american army and a british and canadian army near present-day niagara falls, ontario.

entries.label: Battle of Lutterberg (1762)

entries.label: Battle of Lützen (1632)

entries.label: Battle of Macau

entries.label: Battle of Machias

entries.label: Battle of Maciejowice

entries.label: Battle of Mackinac Island (1814)

entries.label: Battle of Macta

entries.label: Battle of Madana

entries.label: Battle of Madonna dell'Olmo

entries.label: Battle of Madras

entries.label: Battle of Magenta

entries.label: Battle of Magersfontein
entries.lead: the battle of magersfontein was fought on 11 december 1899, at magersfontein, near kimberley, south africa, on the borders of the cape colony and the independent republic of the orange free state.

entries.label: Battle of Magnano
entries.lead: in the battle of magnano on 5 april 1799, an austrian army commanded by pal kray defeated a french army led by barthelemy scherer.

entries.label: Battle of Maguaga
entries.lead: the battle of maguaga was a small battle between british troops, canadian militia and tecumseh's natives and a larger force of american troops near the wyandot village of maguaga in what is now the city of riverview, michigan.

entries.label: Battle of Mahidpur
entries.lead: the battle of mahidpur was fought during the third anglo-maratha war between the indore state of the maratha confederacy and the british east india company at mahidpur, a town in the malwa region, on 21 december 1817.

entries.label: Battle of Maida
entries.lead: the battle of maida was fought on 4 july 1806 between the british and french armies outside maida, calabria during the napoleonic wars.

entries.label: Battle of Mainz

entries.label: Battle of Maipú

entries.label: Battle of Maiwand

entries.label: Battle of Majuba Hill
entries.lead: the battle of majuba hill on 27 february 1881 was the final and decisive battle of the first boer war that was a resounding victory for the boers.

entries.label: Battle of Makahambus Hill

entries.label: Battle of Malakoff

entries.label: Battle of Malatitze

entries.label: Battle of Mallavelly

entries.label: Battle of Maloyaroslavets

entries.label: Battle of Mamora (1696)

entries.label: Battle of Mandora

entries.label: Battle of Maniaki
entries.lead: the battle of maniaki was fought on may 20, 1825, in maniaki, greece between egyptian forces led by ibrahim pasha and greek forces led by papaflessas.

entries.label: Battle of Manila (1574)
entries.lead: the battle of manila (1574) was a battle between chinese and japanese pirates led by limahong and spanish colonial forces with their native allies that took place on 29 november 1574 near manila, mainly in the location of what is now paranaque, in the philippines.

entries.label: Battle of Manila (1762)
entries.lead: the battle of manila was fought during the seven years' war, from 24 september 1762 to 6 october 1762, between the kingdom of great britain and the kingdom of spain in and around manila, the capital of the philippines, a spanish colony at that time.

entries.label: Battle of Manila (1898)
entries.lead: the battle of manila, sometimes called the mock battle of manila, was a land engagement which took place in manila on august 13, 1898, at the end of the spanish–american war, three months after the decisive victory by commodore dewey's asiatic squadron at the battle of manila bay.

entries.label: Battle of Manila (1899)

entries.label: Battle of Manila Bay

entries.label: Battle of Marciano

entries.lead: the battle of prome was a land-based battle between the kingdom of burma and the british empire that took place near the city of prome, modern day pyay, in 1825 as part of the first anglo-burmese war.

entries.label: Battle of Prostki
entries.lead: the battle of prostki was fought near prostki, duchy of prussia on october 8, 1656, between forces of the polish–lithuanian commonwealth and allied crimean tatars commanded by hetman wincenty gosiewski on one side, and on the other allied swedish and brandenburg forces commanded by prince georg frie

entries.label: Battle of Providien
entries.lead: the battle of providien was the second in a series of naval battles fought between a british fleet, under vice-admiral sir edward hughes, and a french fleet, under the bailli de suffren, off the coast of india during the anglo-french war.

entries.label: Battle of Pułtusk (1703)
entries.lead: the battle of pułtusk took place on 1 may 1703 (n.s.) in pułtusk during the great northern war.

entries.label: Battle of Pułtusk (1806)
entries.lead: the battle of pułtusk took place on 26 december 1806 during the war of the fourth coalition near pultusk, prussia.

entries.label: Battle of Pucacasa
entries.lead: the battle of pucacasa took place between 22 and 23 march, 1781, in the quispicanchi province of cusco, between spanish royalists led by jose del valle, and tupac amaru ii's rebel army.

entries.label: Battle of Puebla
entries.lead: the battle of puebla, also known as the battle of the fifth of may took place on 5 may 1862, near puebla de los angeles, during the second french intervention in mexico.

entries.label: Battle of Puente Sanpayo
entries.lead: the battle of puente sanpayo or battle of san payo took place at the eponymous bridge in pontevedra, between 7–9 june 1809 during the peninsular war.

entries.label: Battle of Puerto Cabello
entries.lead: the battle of puerto cabello was a failed attack on a spanish colonial port during the war of jenkins' ear on 16 april 1743.

entries.label: Battle of Puerto de Cavite
entries.lead: the naval battle of puerto de cavite took place on 10 june 1647 during the eighty years' war between a spanish fleet and a dutch fleet in puerto de cavite, an important spanish port in manila bay, philippines in which the dutch were defeated.

entries.label: Battle of Pulang Lupa

entries.label: Battle of Pulo Aura
entries.lead: the battle of pulo aura was a minor naval engagement of the napoleonic wars fought on 14 february 1804, in which a large british east india company (eic) convoy intimidated, drove off and chased away a powerful french navy squadron.

entries.label: Battle of Pulo Buton
entries.lead: the battle of pulo buton (1606) was a naval engagement that took place in pulo buton, between a portuguese fleet commanded by dom alvaro de menezes and a dutch force under cornelis matelief.

entries.label: Battle of Puná
entries.lead: the battle of puna, a peripheral engagement of francisco pizarro's conquest of peru, was fought in april 1531 on the island of puna in ecuador.

entries.label: Battle of Pungdo
entries.lead: the battle of pungdo was the first naval battle of the first sino-japanese war.

entries.label: Battle of Pungo Andongo
entries.lead: the battle of pungo andongo, was a military engagement in what is today angola between portugal and the kingdom of ndongo whose capital, pungo andongo, also known as pedras negras, was besieged.

entries.label: Battle of Punnaikayal
entries.lead: the battle of punnaikayal (1553) was a conflict between the portuguese and a combined force of ottomans, kingdom of calicut and vijayanagara troops.

entries.label: Battle of Punta Colares
entries.lead: the naval battle of punta colares, also known as the battle of corales, was the first major naval engagement of the cisplatine war.

entries.label: Battle of Punta Malpelo
entries.lead: the battle of punta malpelo was a naval encounter between a peruvian corvette and two gran colombian vessels on 31 august 1828, near the port of guayaquil, and was the first major combat of the peruvian navy as an independent force of the newborn peruvian nation.

entries.label: Battle of Punta Quemada
entries.lead: the battle of punta quemada, fought sometime in january 1525, was a brief encounter between a band of spanish conquistadors and the "warlike natives" of colombia, thought to be a northern tributary tribe to the andean kingdom of quito, subordinate to and as well northern capital of the inca empire.

entries.label: Battle of Purandar
entries.lead: the battle of purandar was fought between the mughal empire and the marathas in 1665.

entries.label: Battle of Puruarán
entries.lead: the battle of puruaran took place during the war of mexican independence on 5 january 1814 in the area around puruaran, michoacan.

entries.label: Battle of Pyliavtsi
entries.lead: the battle of pyliavtsi was the third significant battle of the khmelnytsky uprising.

entries.label: Battle of Pyongyang (1592)
entries.lead: the battle of pyongyang was a military engagement in 1592, as part of the 1592–1598 japanese invasions of korea.

entries.label: Battle of Pyongyang (1894)
entries.lead: the battle of pyongyang was the second major land battle of the first sino-japanese war.

entries.label: Battle of Qarabagh (1469)
entries.lead: the battle of qarabagh was fought on february 4, 1469, between aq qoyunlu under uzun hasan, and the timurids of samarkand under abu sa'id mirza, resulting in the latter's defeat, imprisonment and execution.

entries.label: Battle of Qbaada

entries.label: Battle of Qinghe
entries.lead: the battle of qinghe was a military conflict between the later jin dynasty and the ming dynasty in the summer of 1618.

entries.label: Battle of Quatre Bras
entries.lead: the battle of quatre bras was fought on 16 june 1815, as a preliminary engagement to the decisive battle of waterloo that occurred two days later.

entries.label: Battle of Quebec (1690)
entries.lead: the battle of quebec was fought in october 1690 between the colonies of new france and massachusetts bay, then ruled by the kingdoms of france and england, respectively.

entries.label: Battle of Quebec (1775)
entries.lead: the battle of quebec was fought on december 31, 1775, between american continental army forces and the british defenders of quebec city as part of the invasion of quebec of the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Queenston Heights
entries.lead: the battle of queenston heights was the first major engagement of the war of 1812.

entries.label: Battle of Quiapo
entries.lead: battle of quiapo in the arauco war was the final battle in the campaign of garcia hurtado de mendoza against the mapuche under the toqui known as lemucaguin or caupolican the younger.

entries.label: Battle of Quiberon Bay
entries.lead: the battle of quiberon bay was a decisive naval engagement during the seven years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Quiévrain (1792)

entries.label: Battle of Quilacura

entries.label: Battle of Raab (1809)

entries.label: Battle of Racławice

entries.label: Battle of Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút
entries.lead: the battle of rach gam-xoai mut was fought between the vietnamese tay son forces and an army of siam in present-day kim son commune, đong thap province of vietnam on 20 january 1785.

entries.label: Battle of Raichur
entries.lead: the battle of raichur was fought between the vijayanagara empire and the sultanate of bijapur in 1520 in the town of raichur, india.

entries.label: Battle of Rain

entries.label: Battle of Rakvere (1603)

entries.label: Battle of Ramillies

entries.label: Battle of Ramnagar

entries.label: Battle of Ramu

entries.label: Battle of Rancagua

entries.label: Battle of Randeniwela

entries.label: Battle of Ras Lanuf

entries.label: Battle of Raszyn (1809)
entries.lead: the battle of raszyn was fought on 19 april 1809 between armies of the austrian empire under archduke ferdinand karl joseph of austria-este and the duchy of warsaw under jozef antoni poniatowski, as part of the war of the fifth coalition in the napoleonic wars.

entries.label: Battle of Rathenow

entries.label: Battle of Rathmines

entries.label: Battle of Rauge
entries.lead: the battle of rauge took place on 15 september 1701 near rouge, livonia during the great northern war in which the swedes defeated the numerically superior russians.

entries.label: Battle of Ravenna (1512)

entries.label: Battle of Renty

entries.label: Battle of Resaca

entries.lead: the battle of rheinberg took place on 12 june 1758 in rheinberg, germany during the seven years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Sabana Real

entries.lead: the battle of shepherdstown, also known as the battle of boteler's ford, took place september 19–20, 1862, at boteler's ford along the potomac river, during the maryland campaign of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Sheriffmuir
entries.lead: the battle of sheriffmuir was an engagement in 1715 at the height of the jacobite rising in scotland.

entries.label: Battle of Shigino
entries.lead: the battle of shigino, fought in the final months of 1614, was one battle during the siege of osaka, a campaign by the tokugawa shogunate to destroy or subjugate the last resistance to its power, the toyotomi clan.

entries.label: Battle of Shiloh
entries.lead: the battle of shiloh, also known as the battle of pittsburg landing, was a major battle in the american civil war fought on april 6–7, 1862.

entries.label: Battle of Shimbra Kure
entries.lead: the battle of shimbra kure was fought on 9 march 1529 between the forces of adal led by imam ahmad ibn ibrahim al-ghazi, and the abyssinian army, under dawit ii.

entries.label: Battle of Shimonoseki Straits
entries.lead: the battle of shimonoseki straits was a naval engagement fought on july 16, 1863, by the united states navy warship uss wyoming against the powerful daimyo mori takachika of the choshu clan based in shimonoseki.

entries.label: Battle of Shiojiritoge
entries.lead: the 1548 battle of shiojiritoge was one of many battles fought by takeda shingen in his bid to conquer japan's shinano province.

entries.label: Battle of Shipka Pass
entries.lead: the battle of shipka pass consisted of four battles that were fought between the russian empire, aided by bulgarian volunteers known as opalchentsi, and the ottoman empire for control over the vital shipka pass during the russo-turkish war (1877–1878).

entries.label: Battle of Shipu
entries.lead: the battle of shipu was a french naval victory during the sino-french war.

entries.label: Battle of Shiroyama
entries.lead: the battle of shiroyama took place on 24 september 1877, in kagoshima, japan.

entries.label: Battle of Shizugatake
entries.lead: the battle of shizugatake took place during the sengoku period of japan between toyotomi hideyoshi and shibata katsuie in nagahama, omi province over a period of two days beginning on the 20th day of the fourth month of tensho 11.

entries.label: Battle of Shklow
entries.lead: the battle of shklov took place on august 12, 1654, and was one of the first battles of the russo-polish war (1654–67); it ended with a indecisive, however, by other sources.

entries.label: Battle of Sholinghur
entries.lead: the battle of sholinghur was fought on 27 september 1781 at sholinghur, 80 kilometres (50 mi) west of chennai (madras), between forces of the kingdom of mysore led by hyder ali and east india company forces led by general eyre coote.

entries.label: Battle of Shopian
entries.lead: the battle of shopian took place on 3 july 1819 between an expeditionary force from the sikh empire and jabbar khan, the governor of the kashmir valley province of the durrani empire.

entries.label: Battle of Short Hills
entries.lead: the battle of the short hills was a conflict between a continental army force commanded by brigadier general william alexander, and an opposing british force commanded by lieutenant general william howe.

entries.label: Battle of Shubra Khit
entries.lead: the battle of shubra khit was the second major engagement of the french invasion of egypt and syria and took place on 13 july 1798.

entries.label: Battle of Sialkot (1761)
entries.lead: the battle of sialkot was fought between durrani empire and sukerchakia misl of dal khalsa in 1761.

entries.label: Battle of Sialkot (1763)
entries.lead: the battle of sialkot took place on 12 november 1763, between the durrani empire, led by jahan khan, and the sukerchakia misl, led by charat singh, as part of the afghan–sikh wars which concluded with sikh victory.

entries.label: Battle of Sidi Brahim
entries.lead: the battle of sidi brahim, 23 to 25 september 1845, took place during the french conquest of algeria, near souahlia in tlemcen province.

entries.label: Battle of Sidon (1840)
entries.lead: the battle of sidon was an engagement between the anglo-austro-ottoman and the egyptian forces.

entries.label: Battle of Sierra Bullones
entries.lead: the battle of sierra de bullones was the first big battle between spain and morocco during the hispano-moroccan war.

entries.label: Battle of Sievershausen
entries.lead: the battle of sievershausen occurred on 9 july 1553 near the village of sievershausen, where the forces of the hohenzollern margrave albert alcibiades of brandenburg-kulmbach fought against the united troops of elector maurice of saxony and duke henry v of brunswick-wolfenbuttel.

entries.label: Battle of Sig
entries.lead: in the battle of sig, french forces, assisted by the douair and smela tribes, fought the algerian resistance led by emir abdelkader in the forest of moulay-ismael near sig.

entries.label: Battle of Signal Hill
entries.lead: the battle of signal hill, fought on 15 september 1762, was the last battle of the seven years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Siikajoki
entries.lead: the battle of siikajoki was fought between swedish and russian troops on 18 april 1808 at siikajoki, approximately 60 km south of uleaborg, swedish finland.

entries.label: Battle of Sikkak
entries.lead: the battle of sikkak was a battle within the 2nd karedian war during the french conquest of algeria period.

entries.label: Battle of Silkaatsnek
entries.lead: the battle of silkaatsnek was a military engagement in the anglo-boer war on july 11, 1900, at the silkaatsnek mountain pass, between pretoria and rustenburg.

entries.label: Battle of Sincouwaan
entries.lead: the battle of sincouwaan, also known as battle of veniaga island, was a naval battle between the ming dynasty coast guard and a portuguese fleet led by martim afonso de mello that occurred in 1522.

entries.label: Battle of Sinhagad
entries.lead: the battle of sinhagad, also known as battle of kondhana, involved an attack by marathas during the night of 4 february 1670 on the mughal fort of sinhagad, near the city of pune, maharashtra.

entries.label: Battle of Sinop
entries.lead: the battle of sinop, or the battle of sinope, was a naval battle that took place on 30 november 1853 between imperial russia and the ottoman empire during the opening phase of the crimean war (1853–1856).

entries.label: Battle of Sinsheim
entries.lead: the battle of sinsheim took place on 16 june 1674, near sinsheim in modern baden-wurttemberg, then in the holy roman empire.

entries.label: Battle of Sirhind (1555)
entries.lead: the battle of sirhind was fought between the mughal empire and the sur empire in 1555.

entries.label: Battle of Sirhind (1764)
entries.lead: the battle of sirhind was fought between durrani empire and sikh misls on 14 january 1764.

entries.label: Battle of Sirte (2011)
entries.lead: the battle of sirte was the final and most decisive battle of the first libyan civil war, beginning when the national liberation army attacked the last remnants of the libyan army still loyal to muammar gaddafi in his hometown and designated capital of sirte, on the gulf of sidra.

entries.label: Battle of Sisak
entries.lead: the battle of sisak was fought on 22 june 1593 between ottoman bosnian forces and a combined christian army from the habsburg lands, mainly the kingdom of croatia and inner austria.

entries.label: Battle of Sitka
entries.lead: the battle of sitka in 1804 was the last major armed conflict between the russians and alaska natives, and was initiated in response to the destruction of a russian trading post two years before.

entries.label: Battle of Sittimungulum
entries.lead: the battle of sittimungulum was a series of battles and skirmishes fought between 13 and 15 september 1790, during the third anglo-mysore war, in and near the town now known as sathyamangalam in the southern part of the sultanate of mysore.

entries.label: Battle of Skalitz
entries.lead: the battle of skalitz was a minor engagement in the koniggratz/sadowa campaign of the austro-prussian war of 1866 in bohemia on 28 june.

entries.label: Battle of Skopelos
entries.lead: the battle of skopelos was fought on 5–6 july 1808 off skopelos in the aegean sea during the anglo-turkish war of 1807–1809.

entries.label: Battle of Slankamen
entries.lead: the battle of slankamen was fought on 19 august 1691, near slankamen in the ottoman sanjak of syrmia, between the ottoman empire, and habsburg austrian forces during the great turkish war.

entries.label: Battle of Slim Buttes
entries.lead: the battle of slim buttes was fought on september 9–10, 1876, in the great sioux reservation between the united states army and miniconjou sioux during the great sioux war of 1876.

entries.label: Battle of Slivnitsa
entries.lead: the battle of slivnitsa was a battle between the bulgarian army and the royal serbian army from 17 to 19 november 1885, in the serbo-bulgarian war.

entries.label: Battle of Sluis (1603)
entries.lead: the battle of sluis was a naval battle during the eighty years' war in which a spanish squadron commanded by the italian captain federico spinola tried to break through a blockade of sluis by dutch ships under the command of joos de moor.

entries.label: Battle of Smolensk (1812)
entries.lead: the battle of smolensk was the first major battle of the french invasion of russia.

entries.label: Battle of Smoliani
entries.lead: at the battle of smoliani or smolyany, the russians under general peter wittgenstein defeated the french forces of marshal claude victor and marshal nicholas oudinot.

entries.label: Battle of Sobota
entries.lead: the battle of sobota took place near sobota, poland, on 23 august 1655, between the armies of the polish–lithuanian commonwealth on the one hand and of sweden on the other.

entries.label: Battle of Sobraon
entries.lead: the battle of sobraon was fought on 10 february 1846, between the forces of the east india company and the sikh khalsa army.

entries.label: Battle of Sokal
entries.lead: the battle of sokal was a battle between the army of the grand duchy of lithuania and the kingdom of poland under the command of the grand hetman of the lithuanian prince konstanty ostrogski against the crimean khanate, which took place on august 2, 1519.

entries.label: Battle of Sokhoista
entries.lead: the battle of sokhoista was fought between the ottoman and georgian armies at the sokhoista field in what is now northeastern turkey in 1545.

entries.label: Battle of Solebay
entries.lead: the battle of solebay took place on 6 june 1672 new style, during the third anglo-dutch war, near southwold, suffolk, in eastern england.

entries.label: Battle of Solferino
entries.lead: the battle of solferino on 24 june 1859 was the climactic battle of the second italian war of independence and resulted in the victory of the allied french army under napoleon iii and the piedmont-sardinian army under victor emmanuel ii against the austrian army under emperor franz joseph i.

entries.label: Battle of Solway Moss
entries.lead: the battle of solway moss took place on solway moss near the river esk on the english side of the anglo-scottish border in november 1542 between english and scottish forces.

entries.label: Battle of Somosierra
entries.lead: the battle of somosierra took place on 30 november 1808, during the peninsular war, when a combined franco-napoleonic spanish-polish force under the direct command of napoleon i forced a passage through a spanish division stationed at the sierra de guadarrama, which shielded madrid from direct frenc

entries.label: Battle of Song-Jin

entries.label: Battle of Soor

entries.label: Battle of Sopachuy
entries.lead: the battle of sopachuy was an armed confrontation that occurred on 12 june 1817 in the village of sopachuy, some 120 kilometers southeast from the city of chuquisaca, between a division of the army of the north of the united provinces of the rio de la plata, commanded by lieutenant colonel gregorio

entries.label: Battle of Sorauren
entries.lead: the battle of sorauren was part of a series of engagements in late july 1813 called the battle of the pyrenees in which a combined british, portuguese, and spanish force under sir arthur wellesley held off marshal soult's french forces attempting to relieve pamplona.

entries.label: Battle of Sorel
entries.lead: the battle of sorel occurred on june 19, 1610, with samuel de champlain supported by the kingdom of france and his allies, the wendat (huron), algonquin people, and innu (montagnais) that fought against the mohawk people in new france at present-day sorel-tracy, quebec.

entries.label: Battle of South Mills

entries.label: Battle of South Mountain
entries.lead: the battle of south mountain, known in several early southern accounts as the battle of boonsboro gap, was fought on september 14, 1862, as part of the maryland campaign of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Speyerbach
entries.lead: the battle of speyerbach took place on 15 november 1703 during the war of the spanish succession, near speyer in the rhineland-palatinate.

entries.label: Battle of Sphacteria (1825)
entries.lead: the battle of sphacteria took place during the greek war of independence on 8 may 1825 in sphacteria between the egyptian forces of ibrahim pasha and greek forces led by captain anastasios tsamados along with alexandros mavrokordatos.

entries.label: Battle of Spicheren
entries.lead: the battle of spicheren was fought on 6 august 1870 during the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Battle of Spion Kop
entries.lead: the battle of spion kop was a military engagement between british forces and two boer republics, the south african republic and the orange free state, during the campaign by the british to relieve the besieged city ladysmith during the initial months of the second boer war.

entries.label: Battle of Spring Hill

entries.label: Battle of Stadtlohn
entries.lead: the battle of stadtlohn was fought on 6 august 1623 between the armies of the electoral palatinate and of the catholic league during the thirty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Staffarda
entries.lead: the battle of staffarda took place on 18 august 1690 during the nine years' war in piedmont, northern italy.

entries.label: Battle of Stäket
entries.lead: the battle of staket was a minor battle on 24 august 1719 (n.s.) during the great northern war.

entries.label: Battle of Stalingrad
entries.lead: the battle of stalingrad was a major battle on the eastern front of world war ii in which nazi germany and its axis allies fought the soviet union for control of the city of stalingrad in southern russia.

entries.label: Battle of Stångebro
entries.lead: the battle of stangebro, or the battle of linkoping, took place at linkoping, sweden, on 25 september 1598 (o.s.) and effectively ended the personal union between sweden and the polish–lithuanian commonwealth, that had formed in 1592.

entries.label: Battle of Staouéli
entries.lead: battle of staoueli was a battle between the kingdom of france and the regency of algiers in western algiers while france was trying to take control over the capital.

entries.label: Battle of Staten Island
entries.lead: the battle of staten island was a failed raid by continental army troops under major general john sullivan against british forces on staten island on august 22, 1777, during the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Stavyshche
entries.lead: the battle of stavyshche, also called the siege of stawiszcze, took place between july 7 - october 7, 1664, during the russo-polish war (1654–67).

entries.label: Battle of Steenkerque
entries.lead: the battle of steenkerque was fought on 3 august 1692, during the nine years' war, near steenkerque in belgium, then part of the spanish netherlands.

entries.label: Battle of Stegeborg
entries.lead: the battle of stegeborg took place in a meadow near stegeborg castle, sweden on september 18 (n.s.), or september 8 (o.s.), 1598.

entries.label: Battle of Štěrboholy
entries.lead: the battle of prague, also known as battle of sterboholy, was fought on 6 may 1757, during the third silesian war and the broader seven years' war, between the kingdom of prussia and habsburg austria.

entries.label: Battle of Stirling's Plantation
entries.lead: the battle of stirling's plantation, also known as the battle of fordoche bridge, was an american civil war battle took place on september 29, 1863 in pointe coupee parish, louisiana.

entries.label: Battle of Stołowicze
entries.lead: the battle of stołowicze was a clash of the war of the bar confederation.

entries.label: Battle of Stockach (1799)
entries.lead: the battle of stockach occurred on 25 march 1799, when french and austrian armies fought for control of the geographically strategic hegau region in present-day baden-wurttemberg.

entries.label: Battle of Stoke Field
entries.lead: the battle of stoke field, which took place at east stoke, nottinghamshire, on 16 june 1487, may be considered the last battle of the wars of the roses, since it was the last major engagement between contenders for the throne whose claims derived from descent from the houses of lancaster and york.

entries.label: Battle of Stones River
entries.lead: the battle of stones river, also known as the second battle of murfreesboro, was fought from december 31, 1862, to january 2, 1863, in middle tennessee, as the culmination of the stones river campaign in the western theater of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Stoney Creek
entries.lead: the battle of stoney creek was fought on 6 june 1813, during the war of 1812 near what is now stoney creek, ontario, canada.

entries.label: Battle of Stony Lake
entries.lead: the battle of stony lake was the third and last engagement of henry hastings sibley's 1863 campaign against the santee, yankton, yanktonai and teton sioux in dakota territory.

entries.label: Battle of Stony Point
entries.lead: the battle of stony point took place on july 16, 1779, during the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Stormberg
entries.lead: the battle of stormberg was a british assault on stormberg junction on 10 december 1899 during the second boer war.

entries.label: Battle of Strasbourg Bridge
entries.lead: the battle of strasbourg bridge, 26 to 27 september 1634, took place during the thirty years' war, outside the free imperial city of strasbourg.

entries.label: Battle of Stresow
entries.lead: the landing on groß stresow by an anti-swedish coalition prussian, norwegian, danish and saxon troops took place on 15 november 1715 on the island of rugen during the great northern war.

entries.label: Battle of Stromboli
entries.lead: the battle of stromboli, also known as the second battle of stromboli or the battle of alicudi, took place on 8 january, 1676, during the franco-dutch war.

entries.label: Battle of Suakin
entries.lead: the battle of suakin, occurred on 20 december 1888 during the mahdist war, when general francis grenfell defeated a mahdist, force near suakin, a chief port of sudan.

entries.label: Battle of Suakin (1541)
entries.lead: the battle of suakin of 1541 was an armed encounter that took place in 1541 in the city of suakin, held by the ottoman empire, and which was attacked, sacked and razed by portuguese forces under the command of the portuguese governor of india, dom estevao da gama.

entries.label: Battle of Sudoměř
entries.lead: the battle of sudomer was fought on 25 march 1420, between catholic and hussite forces.

entries.label: Battle of Suez (1541)
entries.lead: the battle of suez occurred in 1541 and was a failed attack by the portuguese against the ottomans.

entries.label: Battle of Sufiyan
entries.lead: the battle of sufiyan took place on 6 november 1605, during the ottoman–safavid war of 1603–1618.

entries.label: Battle of Suipacha
entries.lead: the battle of suipacha was fought on 7 november 1810 in bolivia during the bolivian war of independence between the spanish colonial army and the republican forces sent by the primera junta from buenos aires.

entries.label: Battle of Sullivan's Island
entries.lead: the battle of sullivan's island was fought on june 28, 1776, at sullivan's island, south carolina during the southern theater of the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Sultanabad
entries.lead: the battle of sultanabad occurred on 13 february 1812, between the russian empire and the persian empire.

entries.label: Battle of Surabaya (1677)
entries.lead: the battle of surabaya was fought in may 1677 during the trunajaya rebellion, in which the dutch east india company defeated the forces of trunajaya and took surabaya on behalf of its ally, the mataram sultanate.

entries.label: Battle of Suriagehara
entries.lead: battle of suriagehara was a battle during the sengoku period of japan.

entries.label: Battle of Suvodol
entries.lead: the battle of suvodol was fought near sjenica between the serbian rebels under karađorđe petrovic and an ottoman army under numan-beg mahmudbegovic in late may 1809, during the first serbian uprising.

entries.label: Battle of Suzdal
entries.lead: the battle of suzdal or the battle of the kamenka river was fought on 7 july 1445, between russians under vasily ii and tatar troops of olug moxammad, who invaded the principality of nizhny novgorod.

entries.label: Battle of Svensksund
entries.lead: the second battle of svensksund was a naval battle fought in the gulf of finland outside the present day city of kotka on 9 and 10 july 1790.

entries.label: Battle of Svistov
entries.lead: the battle of svishtov took place during the russo-turkish war of 1877–1878.

entries.label: Battle of Swally
entries.lead: the naval battle of swally, also known as battle of suvali, took place on 29–30 november 1612 off the coast of suvali a village near the surat city and was a victory for four english east india company galleons over four portuguese galleons and 26 barks.

entries.label: Battle of Świecino
entries.lead: the battle of swiecino also called the battle of zarnowiec or in german die schlacht bei schwetz, took place on september 17, 1462, during the thirteen years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Swift Creek
entries.lead: the battle of swift creek or arrowfield church was fought on may 9, 1864, between union and confederate forces during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Syracuse (1710)
entries.lead: the battle of syracuse was a naval engagement of the war of the spanish succession fought on 9 november 1710, outside the sicilian port of syracuse.

entries.label: Battle of Szczekociny
entries.lead: the battle of szczekociny was fought on the 6 june 1794 near the town of szczekociny, lesser poland, between poland and the combined forces of the russian empire and kingdom of prussia.

entries.label: Battle of Szőreg
entries.lead: the battle of szoreg was a battle in the hungarian revolution of 1848, fought on 5 august 1849 at szoreg, hungary, fought between the hungarian revolutionary army led by lieutenant general henryk dembinski and the main army of the habsburg empire led by field marshal julius jacob von haynau.

entries.label: Battle of Tabaruzaka

entries.label: Battle of Tabocas

entries.label: Battle of Tacna

entries.label: Battle of Tacuarembó

entries.label: Battle of Tacuarí

entries.label: Battle of Tacuzcalco

entries.label: Battle of Tadla

entries.label: Battle of Taguanes
