entries.label: Battle of Taku Forts (1858)
entries.lead: the first battle of taku forts was the first attack of the anglo-french alliance against the taku forts along the hai river in tianjin, china, on 20 may 1858, during the second opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Taku Forts (1859)
entries.lead: the second battle of taku forts was a failed anglo-french attempt to seize the taku forts along the hai river in tianjin, china, in june 1859 during the second opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Taku Forts (1860)
entries.lead: the third battle of taku forts was an engagement of the second opium war, part of the british and french 1860 expedition to china.

entries.label: Battle of Takusa
entries.lead: the battle of takusa was a short military engagement fought on 12 april 1853 between the forces of kassa hailu, future emperor of ethiopia, and an alliance of several rival warlords.

entries.label: Battle of Talana Hill
entries.lead: the battle of talana hill, also known as the battle of glencoe, was the first major clash of the second boer war.

entries.label: Battle of Talandongo
entries.lead: the battle of talandongo was a military conflict between the kingdom of portugal and the kingdom of ndongo.

entries.label: Battle of Talavera
entries.lead: the battle of talavera was fought just outside the town of talavera de la reina, spain some 120 kilometres (75 mi) southwest of madrid, during the peninsular war.

entries.label: Battle of Talikota
entries.lead: the battle of talikota, also known as that of rakshasi-tangadi, was a watershed battle fought between the vijayanagara empire and an alliance of the deccan sultanates.

entries.label: Battle of Talisay
entries.lead: the battle of talisay in batangas province, philippines, was fought during the philippine revolution on october 12, 1896, that led to filipino victory.

entries.label: Battle of Tamai
entries.lead: the battle of tamai took place on 13 march 1884 between a british force under sir gerald graham and a mahdist sudanese army led by osman digna.

entries.label: Battle of Tamatave
entries.lead: the battle of tamatave was fought off tamatave in the indian ocean between british and french frigate squadrons during the napoleonic wars.

entries.label: Battle of Tamsui
entries.lead: the battle of tamsui, danshui, or hobe was a significant battle where french military forces were defeated by qing forces at tamsui on taiwan during the keelung campaign of the sino-french war.

entries.label: Battle of Tangier (1437)
entries.lead: the battle of tangier, sometimes referred to as the siege of tangiers, and by the portuguese, as the disaster of tangier, refers to the attempt by a portuguese expeditionary force to seize the moroccan citadel of tangier and its defeat by the armies of the marinid sultanate in 1437.

entries.label: Battle of Tannenberg
entries.lead: the battle of tannenberg, also known as the second battle of tannenberg, was fought between russia and germany between 26 and 30 august 1914, the first month of world war i.

entries.label: Battle of Tarbes
entries.lead: the battle of tarbes was a rearguard action fought on 20 march 1814 between the french army of the south, commanded by marshal nicolas jean-de-dieu soult, and the allied forces under field marshal arthur wellesley, 1st marquess of wellington, during the final phase of the peninsular war.

entries.label: Battle of Tarnab (1448)
entries.lead: the battle of tarnab took place in 1448.

entries.label: Battle of Tarqui
entries.lead: the battle of tarqui, also known as the battle of portete de tarqui, took place on 27 february 1829 at tarqui, near cuenca, today part of ecuador.

entries.label: Battle of Tarutino
entries.lead: the battle of tarutino was a part of napoleon's invasion of russia.

entries.label: Battle of Tarvis (1797)
entries.lead: the battle of tarvis was fought during 21–23 march 1797 near present-day tarvisio in far northeast italy, about 12 kilometres (7 mi) west-by-southwest of the three-border conjunction with austria and slovenia, and was the final battle before the end of the war of the first coalition.

entries.label: Battle of Tashihchiao
entries.lead: the battle of tashihchiao was a land engagement fought on 24–25 july 1904, during the imperial japanese army's advance toward liaoyang in first stage of the russo-japanese war.

entries.label: Battle of Tashiskari
entries.lead: the battle of tashiskari was fought between the georgians and the ottomans at the village of tashiskari on june 16, 1609.

entries.label: Battle of Tashkessen
entries.lead: the battle of tashkessen or battle of tashkesan took place during the russo-turkish war of 1877–1878.

entries.label: Battle of Tatarahama (1569)
entries.lead: the 1569 battle of tatarahama was part of the struggles between the otomo and mori samurai clans during japan's sengoku period, for control of the island of kyushu.

entries.label: Battle of Tatayibá
entries.lead: the battle of tatayiba was a cavalry engagement between a paraguayan force led by future president bernardino caballero and a brazilian force led by luis alves de lima e silva, then marquis of caxias.

entries.label: Battle of Tauberbischofsheim
entries.lead: the battle of tauberbischofsheim was an engagement of the austro-prussian war of 1866, on the 24 july at tauberbischofsheim in the grand duchy of baden between troops of the german confederation and the kingdom of prussia.

entries.label: Battle of Tayabas
entries.lead: the siege of tayabas was a 2-month campaign of the philippine revolution that saw intense guerrilla warfare and bloodshed for the province.

entries.label: Battle of Taza (1553)
entries.lead: the battle of taza occurred in december 1553, it was a battle between the regency of algiers and the saadi sultanate.

entries.label: Battle of Te-li-Ssu
entries.lead: the battle of te-li-ssu, also called battle of wafangou after the nearby railway station, was a land battle of the russo-japanese war.

entries.label: Battle of Tednest
entries.lead: the battle of tednest was an armed engagement that took place in 1514 near the town of tednest in southern morocco, involving portuguese forces supported by moroccan auxiliaries against moroccan forces under saadi sheriff abu abdallah al-qaim.

entries.label: Battle of Tedorigawa
entries.lead: the battle of tetorigawa took place near the tetori river in japan's kaga province in 1577, between the forces of oda nobunaga against uesugi kenshin.

entries.label: Battle of Tell El Kebir
entries.lead: the battle of tel el kebir, fought on 13 september 1882 at tell el kebir in egypt, 110 km north-north-east of cairo, proved the decisive engagement of the anglo-egyptian war of 1882.

entries.label: Battle of Tellicherry
entries.lead: the battle of tellicherry was a naval action fought off the indian port of tellicherry between british and french warships on 18 november 1791 during the third anglo-mysore war.

entries.label: Battle of Temesvár
entries.lead: the battle of temesvar was a key battle in the hungarian revolution of 1848, fought on 9 august 1849 between the austrian empire, led by field marshal julius jacob von haynau, and the hungarian revolutionary army, led by lieutenant general jozef bem.

entries.label: Battle of Tenancingo
entries.lead: the battle of tenancingo was a military action of the mexican war of independence fought on 22 january 1812 on the outskirts of tenancingo de degollado, state of mexico.

entries.label: Battle of Tenango del Valle
entries.lead: the battle of tenango del valle took place during the war of mexican independence in may 1812 on the outskirts of tenango del valle, state of mexico.

entries.label: Battle of Tendra
entries.lead: the battle of tendra was a naval action fought on 8 and 9 september 1790 in the black sea as part of the russo-turkish war (1787–1792).

entries.label: Battle of Tenmokuzan
entries.lead: the 1582 battle of tenmokuzan in japan, is regarded as the last stand of the takeda clan.

entries.label: Battle of Tennōji
entries.lead: the battle of tennoji was fought on 3 june, 1615 between the forces of tokugawa ieyasu and toyotomi hideyori.

entries.label: Battle of Tétouan
entries.lead: the battle of tetouan was fought from 4 to 6 february 1860, near tetouan, morocco, between a spanish army sent to north africa and the tribal levies which at the time made up the moroccan army.

entries.label: Battle of Teugen–Hausen
entries.lead: the battle of teugen–hausen or the battle of thann was an engagement that occurred during the war of the fifth coalition, part of the napoleonic wars.

entries.label: Battle of Tewkesbury
entries.lead: the battle of tewkesbury was one of the most decisive battles of the wars of the roses in england.

entries.label: Battle of Texel
entries.lead: the naval battle of texel or battle of kijkduin took place off the western coast of the island of texel on 21 august 1673 between the dutch and the combined english and french fleets.

entries.label: Battle of Thann (1638)
entries.lead: the battle of thann (1638) was fought between the weimar army in the service of the french, under bernard of saxe-weimar and an imperial-lorraine under charles de lorraine.

entries.label: Battle of the Alcaides
entries.lead: the battle of the alcaides, fought in april 14 1514, was a significant military engagement between the forces of the sultan of fez and the portuguese defenders, along with their local allies, near the town of boulaouane.

entries.label: Battle of the Alma
entries.lead: the battle of the alma took place during the crimean war between an allied expeditionary force and russian forces defending the crimean peninsula on 20 september 1854.

entries.label: Battle of the Alte Veste
entries.lead: the battle of the alte veste or battle of furth was a significant battle of the thirty years' war in which gustavus adolphus' attacking forces were defeated by wallenstein's entrenched troops.

entries.label: Battle of the Assunpink Creek
entries.lead: the battle of the assunpink creek, also known as the second battle of trenton, was a battle between american and british troops that took place in and around trenton, new jersey, on january 2, 1777, during the american revolutionary war, and resulted in an american victory.

entries.label: Battle of the Atlantic
entries.lead: the battle of the atlantic, the longest continuous military campaign in world war ii, ran from 1939 to the defeat of nazi germany in 1945, covering a major part of the naval history of world war ii.

entries.label: Battle of the Badlands
entries.lead: the battle of the badlands was fought in dakota territory, in what is now western north dakota, between the united states army led by general alfred sully and the lakota, yanktonai, and the dakota indian tribes.

entries.label: Battle of the Barrier
entries.lead: the battle of the barrier was fought between british and chinese forces at the boundary separating macao from mainland china on 19 august 1840 during the first opium war.

entries.label: Battle of the Barrier Forts
entries.lead: the battle of the barrier forts was fought between american and chinese forces in the pearl river, guangdong, china in november 1856 during the second opium war.

entries.label: Battle of the Basque Roads
entries.lead: the battle of the basque roads, also known as the battle of aix roads, was a major naval battle of the napoleonic wars, fought in the narrow basque roads at the mouth of the charente river on the biscay coast of france.

entries.label: Battle of the Basya River
entries.lead: the battle of the basya river or battle of gubarevo took place 28 september 1660 near basya river 40 kilometers from the city of mogilev during thirteen years' war.

entries.label: Battle of the Bay of Velez
entries.lead: the battle of the bay of velez or the battle of velez was a naval battle between the forces of salah reis and a portuguese flotilla in which the forces of salah reis emerged victorious, captured the portuguese squadron and seized the penon de velez.
terms: battle of the bay of velez

entries.label: Battle of the Bidassoa
entries.lead: the battle of the bidasoa was fought on 7 october 1813.

entries.label: Battle of the Big Hole
entries.lead: the battle of the big hole was fought in montana territory, august 9–10, 1877, between the united states army and the nez perce tribe of native americans during the nez perce war.

entries.label: Battle of the Black Mountain
entries.lead: the battle of the black mountain was fought from 17 to 20 november 1794 between the army of the first french republic and the allied armies of the kingdom of spain and the kingdom of portugal.

entries.label: Battle of the Black River
entries.lead: the battle of the black river was a series of conflicts between april and august 1782 during the american war of independence.

entries.label: Battle of the Bogue
entries.lead: the battle of the bogue was fought between british and chinese forces in the pearl river delta, guangdong province, china, on 23–26 february 1841 during the first opium war.

entries.label: Battle of the Bogue (1856)
entries.lead: the battle of the bogue was fought between british and chinese forces at the humen strait (bogue), guangdong province, china, on 12–13 november 1856 during the second opium war.

entries.label: Battle of the Boyne
entries.lead: the battle of the boyne took place in 1690 between the forces of the deposed king james ii, and those of king william iii who, with his wife queen mary ii, had acceded to the crowns of england, scotland and ireland in 1689.

entries.label: Battle of the Cedars
entries.lead: the battle of the cedars was a series of military confrontations in the early stages of the american revolutionary war that occurred during the continental army's invasion of quebec, which began in september 1775.

entries.label: Battle of the Ch'ongch'on River
entries.lead: the battle of the ch'ongch'on river, also known as the battle of the ch'ongch'on, was a battle in the korean war that took place from november 25 to december 2, 1950, along the ch'ongch'on river valley in the northwestern part of north korea.

entries.label: Battle of the Chateauguay
entries.lead: the battle of the chateauguay was an engagement of the war of 1812.

entries.label: Battle of the Chernaya
entries.lead: the battle of the chernaya was fought at the traktir bridge on the chernaya river during the crimean war on august 16, 1855.

entries.label: Battle of the Chesapeake
entries.lead: the battle of the chesapeake, also known as the battle of the virginia capes or simply the battle of the capes, was a fleet action which took place near the mouth of the chesapeake bay on 5 september 1781 during the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of the citadel of Vicenza
entries.lead: the battle of the citadel of vicenza was fought between november 26 and 29, 1509 in vicenza, italy as an episode of the war of the league of cambrai.
terms: battle of the citadel of vicenza

entries.label: Battle of the Col des Beni Aïcha
entries.lead: the battle of the col des beni aicha or battle of thenia, which broke out on 19 april 1871, was a battle of the mokrani revolt between the algerian rebels, and the france, which was the colonial power in the region since 1830.
terms: battle of the col des beni aicha

entries.label: Battle of the Cosmin Forest
entries.lead: the battle of the cosmin forest was a military engagement between the kingdom of poland and a coalition army led by stephen the great consisting of mainly moldavian forces alongside transylvanian, wallachian, ottoman, and crimean deployments.

entries.label: Battle of the Crater
entries.lead: the battle of the crater took place during the american civil war, part of the siege of petersburg.

entries.label: Battle of the Cumberland Gap (1863)
entries.lead: the september 7–9, 1863 fall of the cumberland gap was a victory for union forces under the command of ambrose burnside during his american civil war campaign for knoxville.

entries.label: Battle of the Dardanelles (1654)
entries.lead: this battle, which took place on 16 may 1654, was the first of a series of tough battles just inside the mouth of the dardanelles strait, as venice and sometimes the other christian forces attempted to hold the turks back from their invasion of crete by attacking them early.

entries.label: Battle of the Dardanelles (1656)
entries.lead: the third battle of the dardanelles in the fifth ottoman-venetian war took place on 26 and 27 june 1656 inside the dardanelles strait.

entries.label: Battle of the Dardanelles (1657)
entries.lead: the fourth battle of the dardanelles in the fifth ottoman-venetian war took place between 17 and 19 july 1657 outside the mouth of the dardanelles strait.

entries.label: Battle of the Downs
entries.lead: the battle of the downs took place on 21 october 1639, during the eighty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of the Dunes (1658)
entries.lead: the battle of the dunes, also known as the battle of dunkirk, took place on 14 june 1658, near the strategic port of dunkirk in what was then the spanish netherlands.

entries.label: Battle of the Echinades (1427)
entries.lead: the battle of the echinades was fought in 1427 among the echinades islands off western greece between the fleets of carlo i tocco and the byzantine empire.

entries.label: Battle of the Faubourg St Antoine
entries.lead: the battle of the faubourg saint antoine occurred on 2 july 1652 during the fronde rebellion in france.
terms: battle of the faubourg st antoine

entries.label: Battle of the Gabbard
entries.lead: the battle of the gabbard, was a naval battle fought from 2 to 3 june 1653 during the first anglo-dutch war.

entries.label: Battle of the Gebora
entries.lead: the battle of the gebora took place during the peninsular war between spanish and french armies on 19 february 1811, northwest of badajoz, spain.

entries.label: Battle of the Göhrde
entries.lead: the battle of the gohrde took place during the war of the sixth coalition on 16 september 1813 between french and coalition troops at gohrde, germany.

entries.label: Battle of the Gulf of Oman
entries.lead: the battle of the gulf of oman was a naval battle between a large portuguese armada under dom fernando de meneses and the ottoman indian fleet under seydi ali reis.
terms: battle of the gulf of oman

entries.label: Battle of the Habrah
entries.lead: the battle of the habrah was fought on 3 december 1835 during the french conquest of algeria.

entries.label: Battle of the Head of Passes
entries.lead: the battle of the head of passes was a bloodless naval battle of the american civil war.
terms: battle of the head of passes

entries.label: Battle of the Herrings
entries.lead: the battle of the herrings, also called the battle of rouvray, was a military action near the town of rouvray in france, just north of orleans, which took place on 12 february 1429, during the siege of orleans in the hundred years' war.

entries.label: Battle of the Hill of the Jews
entries.lead: the battle of the hill of the jews was fought in ethiopia in august 1542 between the portuguese forces of cristovao da gama and the adal sultanate.
terms: battle of the hill of the jews

entries.label: Battle of the Hyères Islands
entries.lead: the battle of the hyeres islands was a fleet action fought between a combined british and neapolitan fleet and the french mediterranean fleet on 13 july 1795 during the french revolutionary wars.

entries.label: Battle of the Imjin River
entries.lead: the battle of the imjin river, also known as the battle of solma-ri or battle of gloster hill in south korea, or as battle of xuemali in china, took place 22–25 april 1951 during the korean war.

entries.label: Battle of the Iron Gate
entries.lead: the battle of the iron gate was fought between the army of the kingdom of hungary and the ottoman empire on 18 march and 22 march 1442, near marosszentimre and after at the iron gate pass of transylvania.

entries.label: Battle of the Katzbach
entries.lead: the battle of the katzbach on 26 august 1813, was a major battle of the napoleonic wars between the forces of the first french empire under marshal macdonald and a russo-prussian army of the sixth coalition under prussian marshal graf (count) von blucher.

entries.label: Battle of the Kentish Knock
entries.lead: the battle of the kentish knock was a naval battle between the fleets of the dutch republic and england, fought on 28 september 1652, during the first anglo-dutch war near the shoal called the kentish knock in the north sea about thirty kilometres east of the mouth of the river thames.

entries.label: Battle of the Lake of Two Mountains
entries.lead: the battle of the lake of two mountains took place during the beaver wars between the colony of new france and the haudenosaunee confederacy that occurred on october 16, 1689.
terms: battle of the lake of two mountains

entries.label: Battle of the Lerna Mills
entries.lead: the battle of the lerna mills was fought on 25 june 1825, in lerna, greece between the egyptian forces of ibrahim pasha and greek forces led by general yannis makriyannis, demetrios ypsilantis, andreas metaxas and konstantinos mavromichalis.

entries.label: Battle of the Lines of Elvas
entries.lead: the battle of the lines of elvas, was fought on 14 january 1659, in elvas, between portugal and spain during the portuguese restoration war.
terms: battle of the lines of elvas

entries.label: Battle of the Lisaine
entries.lead: the battle of the lisaine, also known as the battle of hericourt, was fought from 15 january to 17 january 1871 between german and french forces.

entries.label: Battle of the Little Bighorn
entries.lead: the 1876 battle of the little bighorn, commonly referred to as custer's last stand and known to the lakota and other plains indians as the battle of the greasy grass, was an armed engagement between combined forces of the lakota sioux, northern cheyenne, and arapaho tribes and the 7th cavalry regime

entries.label: Battle of the Lys (1918)
entries.lead: the german offensive of 9 april 1918 fell on the lys sector held by the 2nd division of the portuguese expeditionary corps, which was below strength, long overdue for relief and due to be withdrawn within days.

entries.label: Battle of the Malacca Strait (1714)
entries.lead: the battle of the malacca strait was one of the last battles of the war of the spanish succession, fought between 8 and 10 of january in 1714, in violation of the peace of utrecht signed between france and portugal in april 1713.

entries.label: Battle of the Maule
entries.lead: the battle of the maule was fought between a coalition of mapuche people of chile and the inca empire of peru.

entries.label: Battle of the Mincio River (1814)
entries.lead: in the war of the sixth coalition, the battle of the mincio river was fought on 8 february 1814 and resulted in an inconclusive engagement between the french under eugene de beauharnais and the austrians under field marshal heinrich von bellegarde.

entries.label: Battle of the Misrata frontline
entries.lead: the battle of the misrata frontline was a battle during the libyan civil war between pro-gaddafi loyalists and anti-gaddafi forces on the western and southwestern outskirts of misrata, the third largest city in libya.

entries.label: Battle of the Mississinewa
entries.lead: the battle of the mississinewa, also known as mississineway, was an expedition ordered by william henry harrison against miami indian villages in response to the attacks on fort wayne and fort harrison in the indiana territory.

entries.label: Battle of the Mona Passage
entries.lead: the battle of the mona passage was fought on 19 april 1782 between the british and french navies during the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of the Monongahela
entries.lead: the battle of the monongahela took place on july 9, 1755, at the beginning of the french and indian war at braddock's field in present-day braddock, pennsylvania, 10 miles (16 km) east of pittsburgh.

entries.label: Battle of the Nile
entries.lead: the battle of the nile was fought between the royal navy and the french navy at aboukir bay in egypt between 1 and 3 august 1798.

entries.label: Battle of the Oinousses Islands
entries.lead: the battle of the oinousses islands comprised two separate actions, on 9 and 19 february 1695 near the oinousses, a small island group off cape karaburun in western anatolia, between a venetian fleet under antonio zeno and the algerian fleet under mezzo morto huseyin.

entries.label: Battle of the Panaro
entries.lead: the battle of the panaro was a victory for king joachim murat's neapolitan forces over a smaller austrian force under frederick bianchi on 3 april 1815 early in the neapolitan war.

entries.label: Battle of the Plains of Abraham
entries.lead: the battle of the plains of abraham, also known as the first battle of quebec, was a pivotal battle in the seven years' war—whose north american theatre is referred to by americans as the french and indian war.
terms: battle of the plains of abraham

entries.label: Battle of the Punchbowl
entries.lead: the battle of the punchbowl (korean: 펀치볼 전투), was one of the last battles of the movement phase of the korean war.

entries.label: Battle of the Pusan Perimeter
entries.lead: the battle of the pusan perimeter, known in korean as the battle of the naktong river defense line, was a large-scale battle between united nations command (un) and north korean forces lasting from august 4 to september 18, 1950.

entries.label: Battle of the Pyramids
entries.lead: the battle of the pyramids, also known as the battle of embabeh, was fought on 21 july 1798 during the french invasion of egypt and syria.

entries.label: Battle of the Pyrenees
entries.lead: the battle of the pyrenees was a large-scale offensive launched on 25 july 1813 by marshal jean-de-dieu soult from the pyrenees region on emperor napoleon's order, in the hope of relieving french garrisons under siege at pamplona and san sebastian.

entries.label: Battle of the Rice Boats
entries.lead: the battle of the rice boats, also called the battle of yamacraw bluff, was a land and naval battle of the american revolutionary war that took place in and around the savannah river on the border between the province of georgia and the province of south carolina on march 2 and 3, 1776.

entries.label: Battle of the Rosebud
entries.lead: the battle of the rosebud or the battle of rosebud creek took place on june 17, 1876, in the montana territory between the united states army and its crow and shoshoni allies against a force consisting primarily of lakota sioux and northern cheyenne indians during the great sioux war of 1876.

entries.label: Battle of the Saintes
entries.lead: the battle of the saintes, also known as the battle of dominica, was fought between the british and french navies on 9–12 april 1782 off dominica during the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of the Salween River
entries.lead: the battle of the salween river was fought in september 1718 close to the nagqu in tibet, between an expedition of the qing dynasty to lhasa and a dzungar khanate force that blocked its path.

entries.label: Battle of the Scheldt (1574)
entries.lead: the battle of the scheldt also known as the battle of walcheren was a naval battle that took place on 29 january 1574 during the eighty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of the Sesia (1524)
entries.lead: the battle of the sesia took place near the sesia river (latin: sesites or sessite), situated in north-western italy, lombardy, on 30 april 1524, where the imperial–spanish forces commanded by don carlos de lannoy and fernando d'avalos, marquis of pescara decisively defeated the french army under th

entries.label: Battle of the Shangani
entries.lead: the battle of the shangani took place on 25 october 1893 during the first matabele war in what is now zimbabwe.

entries.label: Battle of the Siritsa River
entries.lead: the battle of the siritsa river took place on 27 august 1501 between the forces of the livonian order under grand master wolter von plettenberg on the one side and the forces of the grand duchy of moscow and pskov republic on the other.

entries.label: Battle of the Slaak
entries.lead: the naval battle of the slaak was a dutch victory during the eighty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of the Smala
entries.lead: the battle of the smala took place on 16 may 1843, when the french, led by henri d'orleans, duke of aumale, raided the personal encampment of algerian resistance leader emir abdelkader al-jazairi while al-qadir was absent on a raiding expedition.

entries.label: Battle of the Solent
entries.lead: the naval battle of the solent took place on 18 and 19 july 1545 during the italian wars, between the fleets of francis i of france and henry viii of england, in the solent, between hampshire and the isle of wight.

entries.label: Battle of the Sound
entries.lead: the battle of the sound was a naval engagement which took place on 8 november 1658 during the second northern war, near the sound or øresund, just north of the danish capital, copenhagen.

entries.label: Battle of the Spurs
entries.lead: the battle of the spurs or (second) battle of guinegate took place on 16 august 1513.

entries.label: Battle of the Square
entries.lead: the battle of the square was a skirmish between norwegian demonstrators and military forces of the united kingdoms of sweden and norway that took place in oslo, norway, on the evening of 17 may 1829.

entries.label: Battle of the Strait of Hormuz (1553)
entries.lead: the battle of the strait of hormuz was fought in august 1553 between an ottoman fleet, commanded by admiral murat reis, against a portuguese fleet of dom diogo de noronha.
terms: battle of the strait of hormuz (1553)

entries.label: Battle of the Taku Forts (1900)
entries.lead: the battle of the taku or battle of dagu forts was a short engagement during the boxer rebellion between the chinese qing dynasty military and forces belonging to the eight nation alliance in june 1900.

entries.label: Battle of the Thames

entries.lead: the battle of the yalu river was the largest naval engagement of the first sino-japanese war, and took place on 17 september 1894, the day after the japanese victory at the land battle of pyongyang.

entries.label: Battle of Tirurangadi
entries.lead: the battle of tirurangadi was a series of engagements that took place between 7 and 12 december 1790 at tirurangadi near the port of calicut on the malabar coast of india, during the third anglo-mysore war.

entries.lead: the battle of tlatelolco was fought between the two pre-hispanic altepetls tenochtitlan and tlatelolco, two independent polities which inhabited the island of lake texcoco in the basin of mexico.

entries.label: Battle of Tlemcen (1696)

entries.label: Battle of Topáter

entries.label: Battle of Tornavento

entries.label: Battle of Trnava (1430)

entries.label: Battle of Valtetsi
entries.lead: the battle of valtetsi was fought on 24 may 1821 in valtetsi between the ottoman army and greek revolutionaries.

entries.label: Battle of Valutino
entries.lead: the battle of valutino took place on 19 august 1812 near valutino[ru] and lubino[ru], between a corps of french and allied troops led by marshal ney, about 35,000 strong, and a strong rear-guard of general barclay de tolly's russian army of about 25,000, commanded by the general himself.

entries.label: Battle of Valverde
entries.lead: the battle of valverde, also known as the battle of valverde ford, was fought from february 20 to 21, 1862, near the town of val verde at a ford of the rio grande in union-held new mexico territory, in what is today the state of new mexico.

entries.label: Battle of Vänersborg
entries.lead: the battle of vanersborg was fought between swedish and norwegian forces during the torstenson war in 1645.

entries.label: Battle of Vannarpannai
entries.lead: the battle of vannarpannai was a battle fought in 1619 between the forces of cankili ii, the last ruler of the jaffna kingdom, and the portuguese under phillippe de oliveira.

entries.label: Battle of Varese
entries.lead: the battle of varese was fought on 26 may 1859 at varese (lombardy).

entries.label: Battle of Vargas Swamp
entries.lead: the battle of vargas swamp fought on july 25, 1819, was an engagement of bolivar's campaign to liberate new granada.

entries.label: Battle of Varna
entries.lead: the battle of varna took place on 10 november 1444 near varna in what is today eastern bulgaria.

entries.label: Battle of Varvarin
entries.lead: the battle of varvarin was fought on 5 september 1810 between serbian revolutionary forces supported by russian troops and ottoman forces near varvarin, at the time part of the ottoman empire,.

entries.label: Battle of Vasilika
entries.lead: the battle of vasilika was fought between greek revolutionaries and the ottoman empire during the greek war of independence.

entries.label: Battle of Vaslui
entries.lead: the battle of vaslui was a battle that was fought on 10 january 1475, between stephen iii of moldavia and the ottoman governor of rumelia, hadım suleiman pasha.

entries.label: Battle of Vauchamps
entries.lead: the battle of vauchamps was the final major engagement of the six days campaign of the war of the sixth coalition.

entries.label: Battle of Vedrosha
entries.lead: the battle of vedrosha was fought near the vedrosha river, close to dorogobuzh on 14 july 1500, during the second muscovite–lithuanian war (1500–1503).

entries.label: Battle of Vega Real
entries.lead: the battle of vega real, also called the battle of the holy hill or the battle of jaquimo, took place on 24 march 1495 on the island of hayti between an indigenous alliance and spanish forces, commanded by christopher columbus, bartholomew columbus and alonso de ojeda, with the help of indigenous pe

entries.label: Battle of Vegkop
entries.lead: the battle of vegkop, alternatively spelled as vechtkop, took place on 16 october 1836 near the present day town of heilbron, free state, south africa.

entries.label: Battle of Velasco
entries.lead: the battle of velasco, fought june 25-26, 1832, was the first true military conflict between mexico and texians in the texas revolution, colloquially referred to as the "boston harbor of texas".

entries.label: Battle of Velestino
entries.lead: the battle of velestino (greek: μαχη του βελεστινου, turkish: velestin muharebesi) comprised two separate engagements, which took place on 27 april [o.s.

entries.label: Battle of Velletri
entries.lead: the battle of velletri were two battles between austria and the kingdom of naples in 1744 during the war of the austrian succession around the city of velletri, then part of the papal states.

entries.label: Battle of Venta del Pozo
entries.lead: the battle of venta del pozo, also known as the battle of villodrigo by the french and spanish, was a rear-guard action fought as part of the peninsular war on 23 october 1812 between an anglo-german force led by major-general stapleton cotton and marquess of wellington against french troops under m

entries.label: Battle of Veracruz (1838)
entries.lead: the battle of veracruz, also known as the battle of san juan de ulua, was a naval engagement that pitted a french frigate squadron under rear admiral charles baudin against the mexican citadel of san juan de ulua, which defended the city of veracruz, from 27 november to 5 december 1838.

entries.label: Battle of Verdun
entries.lead: the battle of verdun was fought from 21 february to 18 december 1916 on the western front in france.

entries.label: Battle of Verdun (1792)
entries.lead: the battle of verdun was fought between 29 august and 2 september 1792 between french revolutionary forces and a prussian army during the opening months of the war of the first coalition.

entries.label: Battle of Verkiai
entries.lead: battle of verkiai fought in autumn of 1658 between the polish–lithuanian commonwealth and the tsardom of russia marked the resumption of hostilities in the russo-polish war (1654–67); it ended with russian victory.

entries.label: Battle of Verneuil
entries.lead: the battle of verneuil was a battle of the hundred years' war, fought on 17 august 1424 near verneuil-sur-avre in normandy between an english army and a combined franco-scottish force, augmented by milanese heavy cavalry.

entries.label: Battle of Verona (1805)
entries.lead: the battle of verona was fought on 18 october 1805 between the french army of italy under the command of andre massena and an austrian army led by archduke charles, duke of teschen.

entries.label: Battle of Vertières
entries.lead: the battle of vertieres was the last major battle of the saint-domingue expedition and the final phase of the haitian revolution.

entries.label: Battle of Vienna
entries.lead: the battle of vienna took place at kahlenberg mountain near vienna on 12 september 1683 after the city had been besieged by the ottoman empire for two months.

entries.label: Battle of Vigo Bay
entries.lead: the battle of vigo bay, also known as the battle of rande or sometimes as the battle of redondela bay, was a naval engagement fought on 23 october 1702 during the opening years of the war of the spanish succession.

entries.label: Battle of Vihiers
entries.lead: the battle of vihiers was a battle between royalist and republican french forces at vihiers during the war in the vendee.

entries.label: Battle of Vila Franca do Campo
entries.lead: the naval battle of vila franca do campo, also known as battle of ponta delgada and naval battle of terceira island, took place on 26 july 1582, off the coast of the island of sao miguel in the portuguese archipelago of the azores, during the war of the portuguese succession.
terms: battle of vila franca do campo

entries.label: Battle of Vila Velha
entries.lead: the battle of vila velha or battle of vila velha de rodao took place in october 1762 when a british-portuguese force led by john burgoyne and charles lee surprised and recaptured the town of vila velha de rodao, portugal, from spanish invaders during the seven years' war as part of the spanish invas
terms: batalha de vila velha de rodao

entries.label: Battle of Vilcaconga
entries.lead: the battle of vilcaconga took place during the spanish conquest of the inca empire from november 8–9, 1533.

entries.label: Battle of Vilcapugio
entries.lead: the battle of vilcapugio was a major battle fought on october 1, 1813, during the second campaign of upper peru in the argentine war of independence, where the united provinces forces led by general manuel belgrano were defeated by a royalist army, led by joaquin de la pezuela.

entries.label: Battle of Villabuona
entries.lead: the battle of villabuona was fought on 29 may 1630 in the frazione of villabona in southern lombardy during the mantuan war of succession between an allied franco-venetian army led by the venetian provveditore zaccaria sagredo and the french commander duc de candale on one side and the imperial army

entries.label: Battle of Villafranca (1809)
entries.lead: the battle of villafranca del bierzo took place on 17 march 1809, during the french occupation of leon in the peninsular war.

entries.label: Battle of Villalar
entries.lead: the battle of villalar was a battle in the revolt of the comuneros fought on 23 april 1521 near the town of villalar in valladolid province, spain.

entries.label: Battle of Villaviciosa
entries.lead: the battle of villaviciosa was a battle between a franco-spanish army led by louis joseph, duke of vendome and philip v of spain and a grand alliance army commanded by austrian general guido starhemberg.

entries.label: Battle of Villersexel
entries.lead: the battle of villersexel took place on 9 january 1871 as part of the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Battle of Villiers
entries.lead: the battle of villiers, also called the battle of champigny, was the largest of the french sorties from besieged paris during the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Battle of Villinghausen
entries.lead: the battle of villinghausen, took place during the seven years' war fought on the 15th and 16 july 1761 in the western area of present-day germany, between a large french army and an anglo-german force led by prince ferdinand of brunswick.

entries.label: Battle of Vilnius (1655)
entries.lead: the battle of vilnius was an attack by russian and cossack forces on vilnius, the capital of the grand duchy of lithuania within the polish–lithuanian commonwealth, that occurred on 8 august 1655 during the russo-polish war (1654–67).

entries.label: Battle of Viluma
entries.lead: the battle of viluma, also known as battle of sipe-sipe, was a major battle in the south american wars of independence in which the united provinces of the rio de la plata were decisively defeated in upper peru by the royal army of viceroyalty of peru.

entries.label: Battle of Vimeiro
entries.lead: in the battle of vimeiro on 21 august 1808, the british under general arthur wellesley defeated the french under major-general jean-andoche junot near the village of vimeiro, near lisbon, portugal, during the peninsular war.

entries.label: Battle of Vimory
entries.lead: the battle of vimory, occurred on 26 october 1587 between the french royal (catholic) forces of king henry iii of france commanded by henri i, duke of guise and german and swiss mercenaries commanded by fabien i, burgrave of dohna and the duke of bouillon who were hired to assist henry of navarre's

entries.label: Battle of Vinegar Hill
entries.lead: the battle of vinegar hill was a military engagement during the irish rebellion of 1798 on 21 june 1798 between a force of approximately 13,000 government troops under the command of gerard lake and 16,000 united irishmen rebels led by anthony perry.

entries.label: Battle of Vistula Lagoon
entries.lead: the battle of vistula lagoon was fought on september 15, 1463 between the navy of the teutonic order, and the navy of the prussian confederation which was allied with the king of poland, as part of the thirteen years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Vítkov Hill
entries.lead: the battle of vitkov hill was a part of the hussite wars.

entries.label: Battle of Vitoria
entries.lead: at the battle of vitoria, a british, portuguese and spanish army under the marquess of wellington broke the french army under king joseph bonaparte and marshal jean-baptiste jourdan near vitoria in spain, eventually leading to victory in the peninsular war.

entries.label: Battle of Vlotho
entries.lead: the battle of vlotho was fought on 17 october 1638.

entries.label: Battle of Vučji Do
entries.lead: the battle of vucji do was a major battle of the montenegrin-ottoman war of 1876-78 that took place on 18 july 1876 in vucji do, montenegro, fought between the combined forces of montenegrin and eastern herzegovinian tribes (battalions) against the ottoman army under grand vizier ahmed muhtar pasha.

entries.label: Battle of Vuelta de Obligado
entries.lead: the battle of vuelta de obligado took place on 20 november 1845, in the waters of the parana river, on its right bank and in the north of the province of buenos aires (argentina), in a bend where the river narrows and turns, known as vuelta de obligado, in what is today the town of obligado, in san

entries.label: Battle of Vyazma
entries.lead: the battle of vyazma, occurred at the beginning of napoleon's retreat from moscow.

entries.label: Battle of Vyborg Bay (1790)
entries.lead: the battle of vyborg bay was fought between russia and sweden on 3 july 1790 in vyborg bay off the coast of vyborg during the russo-swedish war of 1788–1790.

entries.label: Battle of Vyšehrad
entries.lead: the battle of vysehrad was a series of engagements at the start of the hussite war between hussite forces and catholic crusaders sent by king sigismund.

entries.label: Battle of Wad Ras
entries.lead: the battle of wad-ras took place on march 23, 1860 within the hispano-moroccan war (1859-1860) that, together with the battle of castillejos and tetouan, completed spain's action in north africa to reduce the hostilities of the riffian bands against ceuta.

entries.label: Battle of Wadi al-Laban
entries.lead: the battle of wadi al-laban occurred in march–april 1558 between saadians and ottoman algerian forces under hasan pasha, the son of hayreddin barbarossa.

entries.label: Battle of Wadi Bou Sefiha
entries.lead: the battle of wadi bou sefiha, also write oued bou sefiha, was a clash between spanish forces and volunteer mujahideen from the hyayna tribe near the bou sefiha river in the tetouan region during the hispano-moroccan war.

entries.label: Battle of Wagram
entries.lead: the battle of wagram was a military engagement of the napoleonic wars that ended in a costly but decisive victory for emperor napoleon's french and allied army against the austrian army under the command of archduke charles of austria-teschen.

entries.label: Battle of Wakefield
entries.lead: the 'battle' of wakefield has traditionally been said to have taken place in sandal magna near wakefield in northern england, on 30 december 1460.

entries.label: Battle of Walcourt
entries.lead: the battle of walcourt was fought on 25 august 1689 during the nine years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Wallhof
entries.lead: battle of wallhof was fought between sweden and the polish-lithuanian commonwealth on 17 january 1626.

entries.label: Battle of Wandiwash
entries.lead: the battle of wandiwash was a battle in india between the french and the british in 1760.

entries.label: Battle of Warburg
entries.lead: the battle of warburg was fought on 31 july 1760 during the seven years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Ware Bottom Church
entries.lead: the battle of ware bottom church was fought on may 20, 1864, between union and confederate forces during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Warka
entries.lead: the battle of warka occurred on april 7, 1656 between the forces of the polish–lithuanian commonwealth, commanded by stefan czarniecki, and the forces of the swedish empire, commanded by frederick vi, margrave of baden-durlach.

entries.label: Battle of Warksow
entries.lead: the battle of warksow took place on the baltic sea island of rugen on 8 january (o.s.)/18 january（n.s.）1678 during the swedish-brandenburg war.

entries.label: Battle of Warsaw (1656)
entries.lead: the battle of warsaw took place near warsaw on july 28–july 30 [o.s.

entries.label: Battle of Warsaw (1705)
entries.lead: the battle of warsaw was fought on 31 july 1705 near warsaw in the polish–lithuanian commonwealth, during the great northern war and the 1701–1706 swedish invasion of poland.

entries.label: Battle of Warsaw (1831)
entries.lead: the battle of warsaw, also known as the battle and storming of warsaw, was fought in september 1831 between imperial russia and poland.

entries.label: Battle of Wartenburg
entries.lead: the battle of wartenburg took place on 3 october 1813 between the french iv corps commanded by general henri gatien bertrand and the allied army of silesia, principally the i corps of general ludwig von yorck with the personal participation of the army commander, gebhard l.

entries.label: Battle of Waterberg
entries.lead: the battle of waterberg took place on august 11, 1904, at the waterberg, german south west africa, and was the decisive battle in the herero uprising.

entries.label: Battle of Waterloo
entries.lead: the battle of waterloo was fought on sunday 18 june 1815, near waterloo, being the last engagement with napoleon i.

entries.label: Battle of Wattignies
entries.lead: the battle of wattignies saw a french army commanded by jean-baptiste jourdan attack a coalition army directed by prince josias of saxe-coburg-saalfeld.

entries.label: Battle of Wauhatchie
entries.lead: the battle of wauhatchie was fought october 28–29, 1863, in hamilton and marion counties, tennessee, and dade county, georgia, in the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Wavre
entries.lead: the battle of wavre was the final major military action of the hundred days campaign and the napoleonic wars.

entries.label: Battle of Waxhaws
entries.lead: the battle of waxhaws was a military engagement which took place near lancaster, south carolina on may 29, 1780, during the american revolutionary war.

entries.label: Battle of Wayna Daga
entries.lead: the battle of wayna daga was a large-scale battle between the ethiopian forces and the portuguese empire and the forces of the adal sultanate and the ottoman empire in the east of lake tana in ethiopia on 21 february 1543.

entries.label: Battle of Waynesboro, Virginia
entries.lead: the battle of waynesboro was fought on march 2, 1865, at waynesboro in augusta county, virginia, during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Weihaiwei
entries.lead: the battle of weihaiwei (japanese: ikaiei-no-tatakai took place between 20 january and 12 february 1895, during the first sino-japanese war in weihai, shandong province, china, between the forces of japan and qing china.

entries.label: Battle of Weissenstein
entries.lead: the battle of weissenstein, or battle of biały kamien, was fought during the polish–swedish war (1600–1611), between sweden and the polish–lithuanian commonwealth on 25 september 1604.

entries.label: Battle of Wenden (1601)
entries.lead: the battle of wenden took place on 7 january 1601, during the polish–swedish war (1600–1611).

entries.label: Battle of Werben
entries.lead: the battle of werben took place during the thirty years' war on 7 august 1631 (n.s.), between the swedish empire and the holy roman empire.

entries.label: Battle of Wertingen
entries.lead: in the battle of wertingen imperial french forces led by marshals joachim murat and jean lannes attacked a small austrian corps commanded by feldmarschall-leutnant franz xaver von auffenberg.

entries.label: Battle of Westport
entries.lead: the battle of westport, sometimes referred to as the "gettysburg of the west", was a battle of the american civil war fought on october 23, 1864, in modern kansas city, missouri.

entries.label: Battle of Wevelinghoven
entries.lead: the battle of wevelinghoven or battle of grevenbroich was one of the final battles of the thirty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Whampoa
entries.lead: the battle of whampoa was fought between british and chinese forces at whampoa island on the pearl river near the city of canton (guangzhou), guangdong, china, on 2 march 1841 during the first opium war.

entries.label: Battle of White Bird Canyon
entries.lead: the battle of white bird canyon was fought on june 17, 1877, in idaho territory.

entries.label: Battle of White Hall
entries.lead: the battle of white hall, also called the battle of white hall ferry, took place on december 16, 1862, in wayne county, north carolina, as part of the union expedition to goldsborough, north carolina, during the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of White Marsh
entries.lead: the battle of white marsh or battle of edge hill was a battle of the philadelphia campaign of the american revolutionary war fought december 5–8, 1777, in the area surrounding whitemarsh township, pennsylvania.

entries.label: Battle of White Mountain
entries.lead: the battle of white mountain was fought on 8 november 1620 outside prague in the early stages of the thirty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of White Oak Swamp
entries.lead: the battle of white oak swamp took place on june 30, 1862, in henrico county, virginia, as part of the seven days battles of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of White Plains
entries.lead: the battle of white plains took place during the new york and new jersey campaign of the american revolutionary war on october 28, 1776, near white plains, new york.

entries.label: Battle of Whitestone Hill
entries.lead: the battle of whitestone hill was a battle of the sioux wars in 1863 in the dakota territory as punishment against the sioux in the aftermath of the dakota war of 1862.

entries.label: Battle of Wiłkomierz
entries.lead: the battle of wiłkomierz took place on september 1, 1435, near ukmerge in the grand duchy of lithuania.

entries.label: Battle of Wiesloch (1632)
entries.lead: the battle of wiesloch occurred on 16 august 1632 during the thirty years' war near the german city of wiesloch, south of heidelberg.

entries.label: Battle of Wijnendale
entries.lead: the battle of wijnendale took place during the war of the spanish succession fought on 28 september 1708 near wijnendale, flanders, between an allied force protecting a convoy carrying ammunition for the siege of lille (1708) and forces of bourbon france and spain.

entries.label: Battle of Wilhelmsthal
entries.lead: the battle of wilhelmsthal was fought on 24 june 1762 during the seven years' war between the allied forces of britain, prussia, hanover, brunswick and hesse under the command of the duke of brunswick against france.

entries.label: Battle of Williamsburg
entries.lead: the battle of williamsburg, also known as the battle of fort magruder, took place on may 5, 1862, in york county, james city county, and williamsburg, virginia, as part of the peninsula campaign of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Williamsport
entries.lead: the battle of williamsport, also known as the battle of hagerstown or falling waters, took place from july 6 to july 16, 1863, in washington county, maryland, as part of the gettysburg campaign of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Willow Grange
entries.lead: the battle of willow grange, which took place on 23 november 1899 at willow grange, south of estcourt, saw the boer forces under general piet joubert defeat the british forces.

entries.label: Battle of Wilson's Creek
entries.lead: the battle of wilson's creek, also known as the battle of oak hills, was the first major battle of the trans-mississippi theater of the american civil war.

entries.label: Battle of Wilson's Wharf
entries.lead: the battle of wilson's wharf was a battle in union lt.

entries.label: Battle of Wilton (New York)
entries.lead: the battle of wilton or battle of greenfield was fought in 1693 in wilton, new york between colonial militia and allied native forces on one hand and french forces and their native allies as part of king william's war.

entries.label: Battle of Wimpfen
entries.lead: the battle of wimpfen took place during the palatinate campaign period of the thirty years' war on 6 may 1622 near wimpfen.

entries.label: Battle of Winceby
entries.lead: the battle of winceby took place on 11 october 1643 during the first english civil war near the village of winceby, lincolnshire.

entries.label: Battle of Winterthur
entries.lead: the battle of winterthur was an important action between elements of the army of the danube and elements of the habsburg army, commanded by friedrich freiherr von hotze, during the war of the second coalition, part of the french revolutionary wars.

entries.label: Battle of Wireless Ridge
entries.lead: the battle of wireless ridge was an engagement of the falklands war which took place on the night from 13 to 14 june 1982, between british and argentine forces during the advance towards the argentine-occupied capital of the falkland islands, port stanley.

entries.label: Battle of Wisniowiec
entries.lead: the battle of wisniowiec took place on 28 april 1512.

entries.label: Battle of Wissembourg (1870)
entries.lead: the battle of wissembourg or battle of weissenburg, the first of the franco-prussian war, was joined when three german army corps surprised the small french garrison at wissembourg on 4 august 1870.

entries.label: Battle of Wisternitz
entries.lead: the battle of wisternitz or dolni vestonice was fought on 5 august 1619 between a moravian force of the bohemian confederation under friedrich von tiefenbach (teuffenbach) and a habsburg army under henri de dampierre.

entries.label: Battle of Witpoort
entries.lead: the battle of witpoort was fought during the second anglo-boer war.

entries.label: Battle of Wittenweiher
entries.lead: the battle of wittenweiher took place on august 9, 1638, near the village of wittenweiher today: wittenweier, a district of schwanau, baden-wurttemberg, which was completely destroyed in the course of the battle.

entries.label: Battle of Wittstock
entries.lead: the battle of wittstock was fought on 4 october 1636, near wittstock in northern germany, during the thirty years' war.

entries.label: Battle of Wofla
entries.lead: the battle of wofla was fought on august 28, 1542, near lake ashenge in wofla (ofla) between the portuguese under cristovao da gama and the forces of imam ahmad ibn ibrahim al-ghazi.

entries.label: Battle of Wolf Mountain
entries.lead: the battle of wolf mountain was fought on january 8, 1877, by soldiers of the united states army against lakota sioux and northern cheyenne warriors during the great sioux war of 1876.

entries.label: Battle of Wolf Ravine
entries.lead: the battle of wolf ravine, also referred to as the disaster of wolf ravine, was a military engagement between the spanish army and the riffian army; the battle was a military disaster for the spanish army.

entries.label: Battle of Wolfenbüttel
entries.lead: the battle of wolfenbuttel took place on 29 june 1641 during the thirty years' war outside wolfenbuttel, lower saxony.

entries.label: Battle of Wolgast
entries.lead: the battle of wolgast took place on 2 september 1628 during the thirty years' war, outside wolgast in pomerania.

entries.label: Battle of Wood Lake
entries.lead: the battle of wood lake occurred on september 23, 1862, and was the final battle in the dakota war of 1862.

entries.label: Battle of Woosung
entries.lead: the battle of wusong (woosung) (chinese: 吳淞戰役) was fought between british and chinese forces at the entrance of the wusong river (present-day huangpu river), jiangsu province, china, on 16 june 1842, during the first opium war.

entries.label: Battle of Worcester
entries.lead: the battle of worcester took place on 3 september 1651 in and around the city of worcester, england and was the last major battle of the 1642 to 1651 wars of the three kingdoms.

entries.label: Battle of Wörth
entries.lead: the battle of worth, also known as the battle of reichshoffen or as the battle of frœschwiller, refers to the second battle of worth, which took place on 6 august 1870 in the opening stages of the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Battle of Wuchang
entries.lead: the battle of wuchang occurred in 1852 during the taiping rebellion in wuchang, part of the modern-day city of wuhan.

entries.label: Battle of Wuhan
entries.lead: the battle of wuhan, popularly known to the chinese as the defense of wuhan, and to the japanese as the capture of wuhan, was the largest, longest, and bloodiest battle of the second sino-japanese war.

entries.label: Battle of Würzburg
entries.lead: the battle of wurzburg was fought on 3 september 1796 between an army of the habsburg monarchy led by archduke charles, duke of teschen and an army of the first french republic led by jean-baptiste jourdan.

entries.label: Battle of Wyoming
entries.lead: the battle of wyoming was a military engagement during the american revolutionary war between patriot militia and a force of loyalist soldiers and iroquois warriors.

entries.label: Battle of Xuzhou
entries.lead: the battle of xuzhou was a military campaign between the empire of japan and the republic of china forces in early 1938 during the second sino-japanese war.

entries.label: Battle of Yaguachi
entries.lead: the battle of yaguachi or battle of cone was a military confrontation that occurred on 19 august 1821 between guayaquil independence troops and grancolombian reinforcements, led by antonio jose de sucre, against royalist troops led by colonel francisco gonzalez.

entries.label: Japan–Korea Treaty of 1876

entries.label: Japan–Korea Treaty of 1910
entries.lead: the japan–korea treaty of 1910, also known as the japan–korea annexation treaty (korean: 한일병합조약), was made by representatives of the empire of japan and the korean empire on 22 august 1910.

entries.label: Japanese Instrument of Surrender
entries.lead: the japanese instrument of surrender was the printed agreement that formalized the surrender of japan, marking the end of hostilities in world war ii.

entries.label: Japanese invasion of French Indochina
entries.lead: the japanese invasion of french indochina was a short undeclared military confrontation between japan and vichy france in northern french indochina.

entries.label: Japanese invasion of Manchuria
entries.lead: the empire of japan's kwantung army invaded the manchuria region of china on 18 september 1931, immediately following the mukden incident, a false flag event staged by japanese military personnel as a pretext to invade.

entries.label: Japanese invasion of Sakhalin
entries.lead: the japanese invasion of sakhalin was the last land battle of the russo-japanese war, and took place from 7 july to 31 july 1905.

entries.label: Japanese occupation of Gyeongbokgung
entries.lead: the japanese occupation of gyeongbokgung palace or the gabo incident occurred on 23 july 1894, during the ceasefire of the donghak peasant revolution and the beginning of the first sino-japanese war.

entries.label: Japonisme
entries.lead: japonisme is a french term that refers to the popularity and influence of japanese art and design among a number of western european artists in the nineteenth century following the forced reopening of foreign trade with japan in 1858.

entries.label: Jaragua massacre

entries.label: Java campaign of 1806–1807

entries.label: Java War

entries.label: Java War (1741–1743)
entries.lead: the java war of 1741 to 1743 was an armed struggle by a joint chinese and javanese army against the dutch east india company and pro-dutch javanese that took place in central and eastern java.

entries.label: Javanese Wars of Succession

entries.label: Jay–Gardoqui Treaty
entries.lead: the jay–gardoqui treaty was a proposed 1786 treaty between the united states and spain that was not ratified.

entries.label: Jay Treaty

entries.label: Jementah Civil War
entries.lead: the jementah civil war broke out in 1879 in jementah in northern johor when tengku alam shah, the heir of late sultan ali of the autonomous principality of muar refused to surrender the principality to the central administration of abu bakar, the then maharaja of johor.

entries.label: Jerez uprising
entries.lead: the jerez uprising was an 1892 peasant rebellion in jerez, spain.

entries.label: Jiajing wokou raids
entries.lead: the jiajing wokou raids caused extensive damage to the coast of china in the 16th century, during the reign of the jiajing emperor in the ming dynasty.

entries.label: Jicarilla War
entries.lead: the jicarilla war began in 1849 and was fought between the jicarilla apaches and the united states army in the new mexico territory.

entries.label: Jindandao incident
entries.lead: the jindandao incident was a rebellion by a han chinese secret society called jindandao, who rose in revolt in inner mongolia in november 1891 and genocidally massacred 150,000–500,000 mongols before being suppressed by government troops in late december.

entries.label: Jintian Uprising
entries.lead: the jintian uprising was an armed revolt formally declared by hong xiuquan, founder and leader of the god worshippers, on 11 january 1851 during the late qing dynasty of china.

entries.label: Jisi Incident
entries.lead: the jisi incident was a military conflict between the later jin dynasty and the ming dynasty, named because it happened in 1629, a jisi year according to the chinese sexagenary cycle.

entries.label: John Brown's raid on Harpers Ferry

entries.label: Joseon–United States Treaty of 1882

entries.label: July Revolution
entries.lead: the july revolution, also known as the french revolution of 1830, second french revolution, or les trois glorieuses, was a second french revolution after the first of 1789–99.

entries.lead: the july victims were members of the croatian people's party who fell victim to a crackdown by the austrian imperial army on july 29, 1845.

entries.label: June Days uprising

entries.label: Junker mutiny

entries.label: Kabo Reform
entries.lead: the kabo reform describes a series of sweeping reforms suggested to the government of korea, beginning in 1894 and ending in 1896 during the reign of gojong of korea in response to the donghak peasant revolution.

entries.label: Kabul Expedition (1842)

entries.label: Kalender Çelebi rebellion

entries.label: Kalmar War
entries.lead: the kalmar war (1611–1613) was fought between denmark–norway and sweden.

entries.label: Kan'ei Great Famine

entries.label: Kandyan commerce raiding against Portugal (1612–1613)
entries.lead: the kandyan naval raid was a series of commerce raidings by the kingdom of kandy against the portuguese empire from 16 may 1612 to 6 march 1613.

entries.label: Kaocen Revolt
entries.lead: the kaocen revolt (kabyle: tagrawla n kawsen) was a tuareg rebellion against french colonial rule of the area around the air mountains of northern niger during 1916–17.

entries.label: Kapp Putsch
entries.lead: the kapp putsch, also known as the kapp–luttwitz putsch, was an abortive coup d'etat against the german national government in berlin on 13 march 1920.

entries.label: Kapsin Coup
entries.lead: the kapsin coup, also known as the kapsin revolution, was a failed three-day coup d'etat that occurred in korea during 1884.

entries.label: Karantina massacre
entries.lead: the karantina massacre took place on 18 january 1976, early in the lebanese civil war.

entries.label: Kargil War

entries.label: Karposh's rebellion

entries.label: Karyagin's Raid
entries.lead: karyagin's raid, also known as the persian campaign of colonel karyagin, and as the qarabagh-ganjeh campaign in iranian sources, was a military campaign that took place during the russo-persian war (1804-1813).

entries.label: Kashmir conflict
entries.lead: the kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the kashmir region, primarily between india and pakistan, and also between china and india in the northeastern portion of the region.

entries.label: Kasos Massacre
entries.lead: the kasos massacre was the massacre of greek civilians during the greek war of independence by ottoman forces after the greek christian population rebelled against the ottoman empire.

entries.label: Katowice Conference
entries.lead: the katowice conference was a convention of hovevei zion groups from various countries held in kattowitz, germany in november, 1884.

entries.label: Katyn massacre
entries.lead: on stalin's written order of march 1940 the nkvd shot some twenty-two thousand polish officers, policemen, border guards, officials and professional men taken prisoner when the soviet union occupied eastern poland in september 1939, at katyn and in the prisons of kalinin and kharkiv.

entries.label: Kautokeino rebellion

entries.label: Kawit revolt

entries.label: La Paz revolution
