entries.label: Spanish colonization attempt of the Strait of Magellan
entries.lead: in the late 16th century, the spanish empire attempted to settle the strait of magellan with the aim of controlling the only known passage between the atlantic and pacific oceans at that time.
terms: spanish colonization attempt of the strait of magellan

entries.label: Spanish colonization of the Americas
entries.lead: the spanish colonization of the americas began in 1493 on the caribbean island of hispaniola after the initial 1492 voyage of genoese mariner christopher columbus under license from queen isabella i of castile.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of El Salvador
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of el salvador was the campaign undertaken by the spanish conquistadores against the late postclassic mesoamerican polities in the territory that is now incorporated into the modern central american country of el salvador.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Guatemala
entries.lead: in a protracted conflict during the spanish colonization of the americas, spanish colonisers gradually incorporated the territory that became the modern country of guatemala into the colonial viceroyalty of new spain.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Honduras
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of honduras was a 16th-century conflict during the spanish colonization of the americas in which the territory that now comprises the republic of honduras, one of the seven states of central america, was incorporated into the spanish empire.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of the iberian part of navarre was initiated by ferdinand ii of aragon and completed by his grandson and successor holy roman emperor charles v in a series of military campaigns lasting from 1512 to 1529.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Oran (1509)
entries.lead: the conquest of oran by the spanish empire took place on may 1509, when an army led by pedro navarro on behalf of the cardinal cisneros seized the north african city, which was controlled by the kingdom of tlemcen.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Oran (1732)
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of oran and mers el-kebir took place from 15 june to 2 july 1732, between the kingdom of spain and the deylik of algiers.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Petén
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of peten was the last stage of the conquest of guatemala, a prolonged conflict during the spanish colonisation of the americas.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Sardinia
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of sardinia, also known as the spanish expedition to sardinia, took place between 22 august 1717 and 30 october 1717.

entries.label: Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of the aztec empire, also known as the conquest of mexico, was a pivotal event that took place during the spanish colonization of the americas, marked by the collision of the aztec triple alliance and the spanish empire with its american indian allies.
terms: spanish conquest of the aztec empire

entries.label: Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of the inca empire, also known as the conquest of peru, was one of the most important campaigns in the spanish colonization of the americas.
terms: spanish conquest of the inca empire

entries.label: Spanish conquest of the Kingdom of Q'umarkaj
entries.lead: the spanish conquest of the kingdom of q'umarkaj took place in the k'iche' kingdom of q'umarkaj in 1524 between the spanish and k'iche'.
terms: spanish conquest of the kingdom of q'umarkaj

entries.label: Spanish conquest of Tripoli
entries.lead: the conquest of tripoli was a maritime campaign led by pedro navarro which captured the city of tripoli in north africa in the name of the crown of aragon in 1510.

entries.label: Spanish Constitution of 1812
entries.lead: the political constitution of the spanish monarchy, also known as the constitution of cadiz and nicknamed la pepa, was the first constitution of spain and one of the earliest codified constitutions in world history.

entries.label: Spanish Enlightenment
entries.lead: the spanish enlightenment was an 18th-century intellectual and cultural movement that was part of the broader western enlightenment.

entries.label: Spanish expedition to Balanguingui
entries.lead: the balanguingui expedition of 1848 was an amphibious campaign organized by governor general narciso claveria y zaldua to capture balanguingui island in the sulu archipelago from the moro pirates, who were using it as a base for their piratical activities.

entries.label: Spanish expedition to Tlemcen (1535)

entries.lead: the treaty of bila tserkva was a peace treaty signed on 28 september 1651, between the polish–lithuanian commonwealth and the ukrainian cossacks in the aftermath of the battle of bila tserkva.

entries.label: Treaty of Blois (1504)
entries.lead: the treaty of blois (1504), also known as the first treaty of blois, was an agreement between louis xii of france and the holy roman emperor, maximillian i and his son archduke philip, the father of the future emperor charles v.

entries.label: Treaty of Blois (1572)
entries.lead: the treaty of blois was signed on 19 april 1572 in blois between elizabeth i of england and catherine de' medici of france.

entries.label: Treaty of Bongaya
entries.lead: the treaty of bongaya was signed on november 18, 1667, between hasanuddin of gowa, ruler of the sultanate of gowa, and the dutch east india company (voc).

entries.label: Treaty of Breda (1650)
entries.lead: the treaty of breda (1650) was signed on 1 may 1650 between charles ii, exiled king of england, scotland and ireland, and the scottish covenanter government.

entries.label: Treaty of Breda (1667)
entries.lead: the peace of breda, or treaty of breda was signed in the dutch city of breda, on 31 july 1667.

entries.label: Treaty of Breslau
entries.lead: the treaty of breslau was a preliminary peace agreement signed on 11 june 1742 following long negotiations at the silesian capital breslau by emissaries of archduchess maria theresa of austria and king frederick ii of prussia ending the first silesian war.

entries.label: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk
entries.lead: signed on 3 march 1918, the treaty took russia out of the first world war on terms that gave up poland, the baltic provinces, finland, ukraine and the caucasus districts — a third of the empire's population and most of its coal and iron.

entries.label: Treaty of Bromberg
entries.lead: the treaty of bromberg or treaty of bydgoszcz was a treaty between john ii casimir vasa and elector frederick william of brandenburg-prussia that was ratified at bromberg (bydgoszcz) on 6 november 1657.

entries.label: Treaty of Brömsebro (1645)
entries.lead: the treaty of bromsebro was signed on 13 august 1645, and ended the torstenson war, a local conflict that began in 1643 between sweden and denmark–norway.

entries.label: Treaty of Brussol
entries.lead: the treaty of brussol was signed on 10 april 1610 in bruzolo between charles emmanuel i, duke of savoy, and henry iv of france, inside the castle of bruzolo,.

entries.label: Treaty of Buchach
entries.lead: the treaty of buchach was signed on 18 october 1672 in buczacz (buchach) between the polish–lithuanian commonwealth under king michał korybut wisniowiecki, who had been unable to raise a suitable army, on the one side and the ottoman empire on the other side, ending the first phase of the polish–ott

entries.label: Treaty of Bucharest (1913)
entries.lead: the treaty of bucharest was concluded on 10 august 1913, by the delegates of bulgaria, romania, serbia, montenegro and greece.

entries.label: Treaty of Bucharest (1812)
entries.lead: the treaty of bucharest between the ottoman empire and the russian empire, was signed on 28 may 1812, in manuc's inn in bucharest, and ratified on 5 july 1812, at the end of the russo-turkish war of 1806–1812.

entries.label: Treaty of Bucharest (1886)
entries.lead: the treaty of bucharest was signed by serbia and bulgaria on 3 march [o.s.

entries.label: Treaty of Butre
entries.lead: the treaty of butre between the netherlands and ahanta was signed at butre, dutch gold coast on 27 august 1656.

entries.label: Treaty of Cahuenga
entries.lead: the treaty of cahuenga, also called the capitulation of cahuenga, was an 1847 agreement that ended the conquest of california, resulting in a ceasefire between californios and americans.

entries.label: Treaty of Cambrai
entries.lead: the treaty of cambrai, also known as the paz de las damas or paix des dames, was an agreement made on 5 august 1529 that ended the french involvement in the war of the league of cognac between french king francis i and emperor charles v, who was also the king of spain.

entries.label: Treaty of Campo Formio
entries.lead: the treaty of campo formio was a peace treaty signed on 17 october 1797 between the french first republic and habsburg monarchy of austria which ended the war of the first coalition.

entries.label: Treaty of Canandaigua
entries.lead: the treaty of canandaigua, also known as the pickering treaty and the calico treaty, is a treaty signed after the american revolutionary war between the grand council of the six nations and president george washington, representing the united states of america.

entries.label: Treaty of Canton
entries.lead: the treaty of canton was the first unequal treaty between sweden-norway and the chinese empire.

entries.label: Treaty of Cardis
entries.lead: the treaty of cardis was a peace settlement made in 1661 between the tsardom of russia and the swedish empire.

entries.label: Treaty of Casalanza
entries.lead: the treaty of casalanza, which ended the neapolitan war, was signed on 20 may 1815 between the napoleonic kingdom of naples on the one hand and the austrian empire, as well as great britain, on the other.

entries.label: Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis
entries.lead: the treaty of cateau-cambresis in april 1559 ended the italian wars (1494–1559).

entries.label: Treaty of Chambord
entries.lead: the treaty of chambord was an agreement signed on 15 january 1552 at the chateau de chambord between the catholic king henry ii of france and three protestant princes of the holy roman empire led by elector maurice of saxony.

entries.label: Treaty of Chaumont
entries.lead: the treaty of chaumont was a series of separately-signed but identically-worded agreements in 1814 between the austrian empire, the kingdom of prussia, the russian empire and the united kingdom.

entries.label: Treaty of Cherasco
entries.lead: the treaty of cherasco was a treaty signed on 6 april 1631 which ended the war of the mantuan succession.

entries.label: Treaty of Chicago
entries.lead: the treaty of chicago may refer to either of two treaties made and signed in the settlement that became chicago, illinois, between the united states and the odawa, ojibwe, and bodewadmi native american peoples.

entries.label: Treaty of Compiègne (1624)
entries.lead: the treaty of compiegne, signed on 10 june 1624, was a mutual defence alliance between the kingdom of france and the dutch republic, for an initial period of three years.

entries.label: Treaty of Concordia
entries.lead: the treaty of concordia, or the partition treaty of 1648, was signed on 23 march 1648, between the kingdom of france and the dutch republic and divided the island of saint martin.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1454)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople was signed on april 18, 1454, between the ottoman empire and the republic of venice.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1479)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople was signed on 25 january 1479, which officially ended the sixteen-year-long war between the republic of venice and the ottoman empire.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1590)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople, also known as the peace of istanbul or the treaty of ferhad pasha, was a treaty between the ottoman empire and the safavid empire ending the ottoman–safavid war of 1578–1590.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1700)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople or istanbul was signed on 13 july 1700 between the tsardom of russia and the ottoman empire.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1724)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople russo-ottoman treaty or treaty of the partition of persia was a treaty concluded on 24 june 1724 between the ottoman empire and the russian empire, dividing large portions of the territory of mutually neighbouring safavid iran between them.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1736)
entries.lead: treaty of constantinople was a treaty between ottoman empire and afsharid iran signed on 24 september 1736, ending the ottoman–persian war (1730–1735).

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1832)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople signed on 21 july 1832 and was the product of the london conference of 1832 which opened in february 1832 with the participation of the great powers on the one hand and the ottoman empire on the other.

entries.label: Treaty of Constantinople (1897)
entries.lead: the treaty of constantinople was a treaty between the ottoman empire and the kingdom of greece signed on 4 december 1897 following the greco-turkish war (1897).

entries.label: Treaty of Copenhagen (1660)
entries.lead: the treaty of copenhagen was signed on 27 may 1660, and marked the conclusion of the second northern war between the swedish empire and the alliance of denmark–norway and the polish–lithuanian commonwealth.

entries.label: Treaty of Copenhagen (1709)
entries.lead: on 22 october 1709, during the great northern war, the alliance between the russian empire and denmark-norway was renewed in the treaty of copenhagen.

entries.label: Treaty of Córdoba
entries.lead: the treaty of cordoba established mexican independence from spain at the conclusion of the mexican war of independence.

entries.label: Treaty of Cusseta
entries.lead: the treaty of cusseta was a treaty between the government of the united states and the creek nation signed march 24, 1832.

entries.label: Treaty of Delft
entries.lead: the treaty of delft, also called the reconciliation of delft, was signed on 3 july 1428 between jacqueline of bavaria and philip the good, count of flanders and duke of burgundy.

entries.label: Treaty of Detroit
entries.lead: the treaty of detroit was a treaty between the united states and the ottawa, chippewa, wyandot, and potawatomi native american nations.

entries.label: Treaty of Dordrecht
entries.lead: the treaty of dordrecht was signed on 14 february 1489 between maximilian i, king of the germans and king henry vii of england.

entries.label: Treaty of Dresden
entries.lead: the treaty of dresden was signed on 25 december 1745 at the saxon capital of dresden between austria, saxony and prussia, ending the second silesian war.

entries.label: Treaty of Easton
entries.lead: the treaty of easton was a series of meetings held at easton, pennsylvania, from 7 to 26 october 1758, involving the governments of pennsylvania and new jersey, and representatives of the haudenosaunee, lenape and other indigenous groups.

entries.label: Treaty of Edinburgh
entries.lead: the treaty of edinburgh was a treaty drawn up on 5 july 1560 between the commissioners of queen elizabeth i of england with the assent of the scottish lords of the congregation, and the french representatives of king francis ii of france to formally conclude the siege of leith and replace the auld a

entries.label: Treaty of El Pardo (1761)
entries.lead: the treaty of el pardo was signed on 12 february 1761 between representatives of the spanish empire and portuguese empire.

entries.label: Treaty of El Pardo (1778)
entries.lead: the treaty of el pardo signed on 11 march 1778 sought to end conflict between spain and portugal in the rio de la plata region, along the modern boundary between argentina and uruguay.

entries.label: Treaty of Elbing
entries.lead: the treaty of elbing was signed between the dutch republic and the swedish empire on 1 september (os) / 11 september 1656, during the second northern war, in swedish-held elbing (elblag).

entries.label: Treaty of Fes
entries.lead: the treaty of fes, officially the treaty concluded between france and morocco on 30 march 1912, for the organization of the french protectorate in the sharifian empire, was a treaty signed by sultan abd al-hafid of morocco under duress and french diplomat eugene regnault on 30 march 1912.

entries.label: Treaty of Finckenstein
entries.lead: the treaty of finckenstein, often spelled finkenstein, was a treaty concluded between france and iran (persia) in the finckenstein palace on 4 may 1807 and formalised the franco-persian alliance.

entries.label: Treaty of Fleix
entries.lead: the treaty of fleix was signed on 26 november 1580 by henry iii of france in le fleix.

entries.label: Treaty of Florence
entries.lead: the treaty of florence, which followed the armistice of foligno, brought to an end the war between the french republic and the kingdom of naples, one of the wars of the french revolution.

entries.label: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1631)
entries.lead: the treaty of fontainebleau was signed on 30 may 1631 during the thirty years' war, at the palace of fontainebleau.

entries.label: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1679)
entries.lead: the treaty of fontainebleau, signed on 23 august (o.s.) / 2 september 1679, ended hostilities between denmark-norway and the swedish empire in the scanian war.

entries.label: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1762)
entries.lead: the treaty of fontainebleau, signed on november 3, 1762, was a secret agreement of 1762 in which the kingdom of france ceded louisiana to spain.

entries.label: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1785)
entries.lead: the treaty of fontainebleau was signed on november 8, 1785 in fontainebleau between holy roman emperor joseph ii, ruler of the habsburg monarchy, and the states-general of the united provinces.

entries.label: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1814)
entries.lead: the treaty of fontainebleau was an agreement concluded in fontainebleau, france, on 11 april 1814 between napoleon and representatives of austria, russia and prussia.

entries.label: Treaty of Fontainebleau (October 1807)
entries.lead: the treaty of fontainebleau was a secret agreement signed on 27 october 1807 in fontainebleau, france between king charles iv of spain and the french emperor napoleon.

entries.lead: the treaty of fort clark was signed at fort osage on november 10, 1808, in which the osage nation ceded all the land east of the fort in missouri and arkansas north of the arkansas river to the united states.

entries.lead: the treaty of fort harmar (1789) was a treaty made between the united states and the haudenosaunee, ojibwe, odawa, potawatomi, sauk, wyandot, and lenape, all indigenous nations with territorial claims within the european land claim acquired in 1783 by the united states from the kingdom of great brit

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Industry
entries.lead: the treaty of fort industry was a successor treaty to the treaty of greenville, which moved the eastern boundary of indian lands in northern ohio from the tuscarawas river and cuyahoga river westward to a line 120 miles west of the pennsylvania boundary, which coincided with the western boundary of

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Jackson
entries.lead: the treaty of fort jackson was signed on august 9, 1814 at fort jackson near wetumpka, alabama following the defeat of the red stick resistance by united states allied forces at the battle of horseshoe bend.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Laramie (1851)
entries.lead: the fort laramie treaty of 1851 was signed on september 17, 1851 between united states treaty commissioners and representatives of the cheyenne, sioux, arapaho, crow, assiniboine, mandan, hidatsa, and arikara nations.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Laramie (1868)
entries.lead: the treaty of fort laramie is an agreement between the united states and the oglala, miniconjou, and brule bands of lakota people, yanktonai dakota, and arapaho nation.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Meigs
entries.lead: the treaty of fort meigs, also called the treaty of the maumee rapids, formally titled, "treaty with the wyandots, etc., 1817", was the most significant indian treaty by the united states in ohio since the treaty of greenville in 1795.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Pitt
entries.lead: the treaty of fort pitt, also known as the treaty with the delawares, the delaware treaty, or the fourth treaty of pittsburgh, was signed on september 17, 1778; it was the first formal treaty between the new united states of america and any native american groups, in this case the lenape, called the

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Stanwix (1768)
entries.lead: the treaty of fort stanwix was a treaty signed between representatives from the haudenosaunee and great britain in 1768 at fort stanwix.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Stanwix (1784)
entries.lead: the treaty of fort stanwix was a treaty finalized on october 22, 1784, between the united states and native americans from the six nations of the haudenosaunee league.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Wayne (1803)
entries.lead: the treaty of fort wayne was a treaty between the united states and several groups of native americans.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Wayne (1809)
entries.lead: the treaty of fort wayne, sometimes called the ten o'clock line treaty or the twelve mile line treaty, is an 1809 treaty that obtained 29,719,530 acres of native american land for the settlers of illinois and indiana.

entries.label: Treaty of Fort Wise
entries.lead: the treaty of fort wise of 1861 was a treaty entered into between the united states and six chiefs of the southern cheyenne and four of the southern arapaho indian tribes.

entries.label: Treaty of Frankfurt (1871)
entries.lead: the treaty of frankfurt was a peace treaty signed in frankfurt on 10 may 1871 by the german empire and the french third republic, at the end of the franco-prussian war.

entries.label: Treaty of Frederiksborg
entries.lead: the treaty of frederiksborg was a treaty signed at frederiksborg castle, zealand, on 3 july 1720, ending the great northern war between denmark–norway and sweden.

entries.label: Treaty of Fredrikshamn
entries.lead: the treaty of fredrikshamn, or the treaty of hamina, was a peace treaty concluded between sweden and imperial russia on 17 september 1809.

entries.label: Treaty of Friendship and Alliance
entries.lead: the declaration of edward, also known as the treaty of friendship and alliance, was signed on 16 march 1740, between king edward i of mosquitia and the british.

entries.label: Treaty of Friendship and Cooperation between Spain and Portugal
entries.lead: mario soares and adolfo suarez signed a treaty of friendship and cooperation between portugal and spain on 22 november 1977; portugal ratified it on 17 april 1978 and spain on 25 april.

entries.label: Treaty of Füssen
entries.lead: the peace of fussen was a peace treaty signed at fussen, between the electorate of bavaria and habsburg austria.

entries.label: Treaty of Gandamak
entries.lead: the treaty of gandamak officially ended the first phase of the second anglo-afghan war.

entries.label: Treaty of Georgievsk
entries.lead: the treaty of georgievsk was a bilateral treaty concluded between the russian empire and the east georgian kingdom of kartli-kakheti on july 24, 1783.

entries.label: Treaty of Ghent
entries.lead: the treaty of ghent was the peace treaty that ended the war of 1812 between the united states and the united kingdom.

entries.label: Treaty of Giyanti
entries.lead: the treaty of giyanti was signed and ratified on february 13, 1755, between prince mangkubumi, the dutch east india company, and sunan pakubuwono iii along with his allies.

entries.label: Treaty of Gorinchem
entries.lead: the treaty of gorinchem was signed in gorinchem on 20 october 1528 between holy roman emperor charles v and duke charles of guelders during the guelders wars.

entries.label: Treaty of Granada (1491)
entries.lead: the treaty of granada, also known as the surrender of granada or the capitulations, was signed and ratified on november 25, 1491, between boabdil, the sultan of granada, and ferdinand and isabella, the king and queen of castile, leon, aragon, and sicily.

entries.label: Treaty of Greenville
entries.lead: the treaty of greenville, also known to americans as the treaty with the wyandots, etc., but formally titled a treaty of peace between the united states of america, and the tribes of indians called the wyandots, delawares, shawanees, ottawas, chippewas, pattawatimas, miamis, eel rivers, weas, kickap

entries.label: Treaty of Greenwich
entries.lead: the treaty of greenwich contained two agreements both signed on 1 july 1543 in greenwich between representatives of england and scotland.

entries.label: Treaty of Greifswald
entries.lead: the treaty of greifswald was concluded on 28 october 1715, during the great northern war.

entries.label: Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo
entries.lead: the treaty of guadalupe hidalgo officially ended the mexican–american war (1846–1848).

entries.label: Treaty of Gulistan
entries.lead: the treaty of gulistan was a peace treaty concluded between the russian empire and qajar iran on 24 october 1813 in the village of gulistan as a result of the first full-scale russo-persian war.

entries.label: Treaty of Hadiach
entries.lead: the treaty of hadiach was a treaty signed on 16 september 1658 in hadiach, cossack hetmanate between representatives of the polish–lithuanian commonwealth and ukrainian cossacks.

entries.label: Treaty of Hamburg (1638)
entries.lead: the treaty of hamburg, signed on 5 march 1638, was the ratification of the important treaty of wismar a full two years after it had been negotiated by cardinal richelieu of france and representatives of queen christina of sweden.

entries.label: Treaty of Hamburg (1762)
entries.lead: the treaty of hamburg was signed on 22 may 1762 in hamburg between sweden and prussia during the pomeranian war, a theater of the seven years' war.

entries.label: Treaty of Hamedan
entries.lead: the treaty of hamedan was a treaty between the ottoman empire and the hotak dynasty signed in october 1727 in hamedan, ending the ottoman–hotaki war (1726–1727).

entries.label: Treaty of Hampton Court (1562)
entries.lead: the treaty of hampton court was signed on 22 september 1562 between elizabeth i of england and french huguenot leader louis i de bourbon, prince de conde.

entries.label: Treaty of Hanover (1710)
entries.lead: the treaty of hanover was concluded on 3 july 1710, during the great northern war.

entries.label: Treaty of Hanover (1725)
entries.lead: the treaty of hanover was a treaty of defensive alliance signed on 3 september 1725 by the kingdom of great britain, the electorate of hanover, the kingdom of france and the kingdom of prussia, an extension of the earlier anglo-french alliance.

entries.label: Treaty of Hartford (1638)
entries.lead: the treaty of hartford was a treaty concluded between english colonists in connecticut, the mohegan nation and the narragansett nation on september 21, 1638, following the pequot war, in hartford, connecticut.

entries.label: Treaty of Hartford (1650)
entries.lead: the treaty of hartford is a treaty concluded between new netherland and connecticut colony on september 19, 1650, in hartford, connecticut.

entries.label: Treaty of Hartford (1786)
entries.lead: the treaty of hartford was a treaty concluded between new york and massachusetts on december 16, 1786 in hartford, connecticut, over the ownership of the land which now comprises western new york.

entries.label: Treaty of Holston
entries.lead: the treaty of holston was a treaty between the united states government and the cherokee signed on july 2, 1791, and proclaimed on february 7, 1792.

entries.label: Treaty of Hopewell
entries.lead: three agreements, each known as a treaty of hopewell, were signed between representatives of the congress of the united states and the cherokee, choctaw, and chickasaw peoples.

entries.label: Treaty of Hubertusburg
entries.lead: the treaty of hubertusburg was signed on 15 february 1763 at hubertusburg castle by prussia, austria and saxony to end the third silesian war.

entries.label: Treaty of Huế (1863)

entries.label: Treaty of Huế (1883)
entries.lead: the treaty of hue, concluded on 25 august 1883 between vietnam and france, recognising a french protectorate over vietnam being divided into annam and tonkin.

entries.label: Treaty of Huế (1884)
entries.lead: the treaty of hue or protectorate treaty was concluded on 6 june 1884 between france and đai nam.

entries.label: Treaty of Hünkâr İskelesi
entries.lead: the treaty of hunkar iskelesi was a treaty signed between the russian empire and the ottoman empire on july 8, 1833, following the military aid of russia against muhammad ali pasha of egypt that same year.

entries.lead: the treaty of indian springs, also known as the first treaty of indian springs and the treaty with the creeks, is a treaty concluded between the muscogee and the united states on january 8, 1821, at what is now indian springs state park.

entries.label: Treaty of Indian Springs (1825)

entries.label: Treaty of Kalisz (1813)
entries.lead: the treaty of kalisz was signed in kalisz on 28 february 1813, between russia and prussia against napoleon i.

entries.label: Treaty of Karlowitz

entries.label: Treaty of Kėdainiai
entries.lead: the treaty of kedainiai or kiejdany, signed on 17 august 1655, was a swedish–lithuanian agreement during the second northern war.

entries.label: Treaty of Kerden
entries.lead: treaty of kerden was signed between the ottoman empire and afsharid iran on 4 september 1746.

entries.label: Treaty of Khotyn
entries.lead: treaty of khotyn (chocim/hotin), signed on 9 october 1621 in the aftermath of the battle of khotyn, ended the polish–ottoman war.

entries.label: Treaty of Kiel
entries.lead: the treaty of kiel or peace of kiel was concluded between the united kingdom of great britain and ireland and the kingdom of sweden on one side and the kingdoms of denmark and norway on the other side on 14 january 1814 in kiel.

entries.label: Treaty of Knäred
entries.lead: the treaty of knared was signed on 21 january 1613 and ended the kalmar war (1611–1613) between denmark-norway and sweden.

entries.label: Treaty of Königsberg (1656)

entries.label: Treaty of Kulja
entries.lead: the treaty of kulja was a treaty between qing china and the russian empire, signed in 1851, opening kulja and chuguchak to sino-russian trade.

entries.label: Treaty of Kurakchay
entries.lead: kurakchay treaty is a contract confirming the integration of the karabakh khanate into the russian empire.

entries.label: Treaty of Kurukove
entries.lead: the treaty of kurukove was an agreement between hetman stanisław koniecpolski of the polish–lithuanian commonwealth and mykhailo doroshenko of the ukrainian cossacks.

entries.label: Treaty of Kyakhta (1727)
entries.lead: the treaty of kyakhta, along with the treaty of nerchinsk (1689), regulated the relations between imperial russia and the qing empire of china until the mid-19th century.

entries.label: Treaty of Kyehae

entries.label: Treaty of Teschen
entries.lead: the treaty of teschen was signed on 13 may 1779 in teschen, then in austrian silesia, between the austrian habsburg monarchy and the kingdom of prussia, which officially ended the war of the bavarian succession.

entries.label: Treaty of Teusina
entries.lead: the treaty of teusina was concluded by russian diplomats under the boyar afanasiy pushkin and ambassadors of the swedish king at the village of tyavzino in ingria on 18 may 1595 to end the russo-swedish war (1590–1595).

entries.lead: the treaty of the bogue was an unequal treaty between the united kingdom and china, concluded in october 1843 to supplement the previous treaty of nanking.

entries.label: Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando
entries.lead: the treaty of the bulls of guisando is the name of a treaty agreed on top of the hill of guisando near the bulls of guisando on 19 september 1468, between henry iv of castile and his half-sister isabella of castile.

entries.label: Treaty of the Dardanelles

entries.label: Treaty of the Eighteen Articles
entries.lead: the treaty of the eighteen articles was a proposal for a treaty between belgium and the netherlands to establish borders between the two countries.

entries.label: Treaty of The Hague (1625)

entries.label: Treaty of The Hague (1661)
entries.lead: the treaty of the hague was signed on 6 august 1661 between representatives of the dutch republic and portugal.

entries.lead: the 1698 treaty of the hague, also known as the 1698 treaty of den haag or first partition treaty was one of two attempts by france, great britain, and the dutch republic to achieve a diplomatic solution to the issues that led to the 1701–1714 war of the spanish succession.

entries.label: Treaty of The Hague (1701)

entries.lead: the treaty of the hague was signed on may 16, 1795, between representatives of the french first republic and the batavian republic.

entries.label: Treaty of the Pruth
entries.lead: the treaty of the pruth was signed on the banks of the river prut between the ottoman empire and the tsardom of russia on 23 july 1711 ending the russo-turkish war of 1710–1713 with the assistance of peter shafirov.

entries.label: Treaty of the Pyrenees
entries.lead: the treaty of the pyrenees was signed on 7 november 1659 and ended the franco–spanish war that had begun in 1635.

entries.lead: signed at tordesillas on 7 june 1494 and ratified by castile on 2 july and by portugal on 5 september, the treaty drew a meridian 370 leagues west of the cape verde islands and gave the lands east of it to portugal and those west of it to castile, amending an earlier bull of alexander vi.

entries.label: Treaty of Traverse des Sioux
entries.lead: the treaty of traverse des sioux was signed on july 23, 1851, at traverse des sioux in minnesota territory between the united states government and the upper dakota sioux bands.

entries.label: Treaty of Trianon
entries.lead: signed on 4 june 1920, trianon fixed the frontiers of hungary after the break-up of austria-hungary and left it with under a third of the kingdom's former territory and some three million hungarian speakers outside its borders, in romania, czechoslovakia and yugoslavia.

entries.label: Treaty of Turin (1860)

entries.lead: the unification of italy, also known as the risorgimento, was the 19th-century political and social movement that in 1861 ended in the annexation of various states of the italian peninsula and its outlying isles to the kingdom of sardinia, resulting in the creation of the kingdom of italy.

entries.label: Unification of Nepal
entries.lead: the unification of nepal was the historical process of military conquest, strategic diplomacy, and state-building through which the hill kingdom of gorkha unified dozens of fragmented kingdoms into the sovereign state of modern nepal.

entries.label: Unified Task Force
entries.lead: the unified task force (unitaf), also known as operation restore hope, was a united states–led, united nations–sanctioned coalition military force deployed to somalia from 5 december 1992 to 4 may 1993.

entries.label: Union of Arras
entries.lead: the union of arras was an alliance between the county of artois, the county of hainaut and the city of douai in the habsburg netherlands in early 1579 during the eighty years' war.

entries.label: Union of Grodno (1432)
entries.lead: the union of grodno was a series of acts of the polish–lithuanian union between kingdom of poland and grand duchy of lithuania.

entries.label: Union of Kraków and Vilna
entries.lead: the union of krakow and vilna, also known as union of vilnius, was one of the agreements of the polish–lithuanian union.

entries.label: Union of Lublin
entries.lead: the union of lublin was signed on 1 july 1569 in lublin, poland, and created a single state, the polish–lithuanian commonwealth, one of the largest countries in europe at the time.

entries.label: Union of Utrecht

entries.label: United States Declaration of Independence

entries.lead: the uprising of dervish cara was a 19th-century uprising in northern ottoman albania directed against the ottoman tanzimat reforms which started in 1839 and were gradually being put in action in the regions of albania.

entries.lead: uss constellation vs la vengeance, or the action of 1 february 1800, was a single-ship action fought between frigates of the french navy and the united states navy during the quasi-war.

entries.label: Utah War
entries.lead: the utah war (1857–1858), also known as the utah expedition, the utah campaign, buchanan's blunder, the mormon war, or the mormon rebellion, was an armed confrontation between the armed forces of the us government and the mormon settlers in the utah territory.

entries.label: Vancouver Expedition

entries.lead: the venetian bombardments of the beylik of tunis were a series of naval bombardments of the capital and various port cities of the beylik of tunis by the venetian navy in retaliation for the support bey hammuda ibn ali gave to barbary pirates who harassed venetian-flagged shipping.

entries.label: Venezuelan Declaration of Independence
